  Last sale: last sale date across all references

  Turnover last 365 d: overall turnover over the last 365 days

  Avg qty per order: average quantity sold by reference x order

  __Weekly Sales by category__: weekly turnover by category in dollars over the last 2 years

  __Last 365 days Best Sellers__: list of all references by decreasing order of best seller in total turnover value over the last 365 days

  Rank: best seller rank

  Inspect: link to the item inspector dashboard which displays all information of the given reference

  Ref: reference code

  Name : reference name

  Supplier: reference supplier

  Qty sold last 365 d: reference quantity sold over the last 365 days

  Value sold last 365 d: reference turnover in dollars over the last 365 days

  Sales Weight: reference proportion of the overall turnover over the last 365 days

  __Pareto on turnover last 365 days__: cumulative overall turnover percentage over the last 365 days depending on the best seller rank

  __Turnover last 365 d by category__: turnover last 365 days split by category

  __Turnover last 365 d by brand: turnover last 365 days split by brand

  __Turnover last 365 d by location: turnover last 365 days split by location

  """


show label "" a2h2 9b9b9b

keep where date >= oend - 3 * 365

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
///------------------------------------------TOTAL OVERVIEW-----------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Items.Sold365 = sum(Orders.Quantity) when(Orders.date >= oend - 365)
Items.ValueSold365 = sum(Orders.NetAmount) when(Orders.date >= oend - 365)
Items.CategoryValueSold365 = sum(Orders.NetAmount) by Items.Category at Items.Category when(Orders.date >= oend - 365)
totalValueSold365 = sum(Orders.NetAmount) when(Orders.date >= oend - 365)

show summary "Overall view" a3a6 with
  min(Orders.date) as "First sale" {textBold: "true"}
  max(Orders.date) as "Last sale" {textBold: "true"}
  totalValueSold365 as "Turnover last 365 d" {numbers: simple ; textBold: "true" ; unit: #(DcUnit)}
  sum(Orders.Quantity) / count(Orders.*) as "Avg qty per order" {textBold: "true"}

Items.CategoryBestSellerRank = rankd(Items.CategoryValueSold365)
firstCategory = same(Items.Category) when(Items.CategoryBestSellerRank == 1)
secondCategory = same(Items.Category) when(Items.CategoryBestSellerRank == 2)
thirdCategory = same(Items.Category) when(Items.CategoryBestSellerRank == 3)

show linechart "Weekly Sales by category" b3h6 with

firstCategory = same(Items.Category) when(Items.CategoryBestSellerRank == 1)
secondCategory = same(Items.Category) when(Items.CategoryBestSellerRank == 2)
thirdCategory = same(Items.Category) when(Items.CategoryBestSellerRank == 3)

show linechart "Weekly Sales by category" b3h6 with
  sum(Orders.NetAmount) as "Overall Turnover" {seriesType: legend}
  sum(Orders.NetAmount) when(Items.Category == firstCategory) as "\{firstCategory} Turnover" {seriesType: bar ; seriesStack: bar ; color: #(linechartA) ; unit: #(DcUnit)}
  sum(Orders.NetAmount) when(Items.Category == secondCategory) as "\{secondCategory} Turnover" {seriesType: bar ; seriesStack: bar ; color: #(linechartAlight) ; unit: #(DcUnit)}

    sum(Orders.NetAmount) as "Turnover"
    group by Items.Loc into Orders

show plot "Pareto on turnover last 365 days" f7h9        {color: #(linechartA)} with
  Items.BestSellerRank as ""
  Items.CumValueSold365 / totalValueSold365 * 100 as "Cumulative Turnover %"

  #### 💡 Technical Pre-Processing

  __The Technical Pre-Processing Reads all required input files from the predefined input folder and__
  __safes a first temporary version of every file in `/input/tmp/`.__
  __The script indicates all indicates all structural data issues that may cause script errors or disappearing of code lines.__


  #### Steps:
  1. Reading in Tables: At first, all relevant input tables are read in.
  2. Detect Keys: In order to link the tables, that were read in, a unique identifier has to
  be found (key). The most important key is a unique item name.
  3. Detect Orphans: When all tables are read in and key are detected, a first test is done to see if
  inputs can be linked over similar keys (Item Reference, Id, Supplier name ... etc).
  All lose ends will be flagged as Data health Booleans.
  4. Document Information: Get file information of read files.
  5. Export Tables: Export all processed tables to `/input/tmp/`, including the created data health booleans.
  """

[Reads: Catalog.ion]
[Reads: Forecast.ion]

/// Dashboard to choose target ambition - All Granularity Level

read "/Clean/LongTermPlanning/Catalog.ion" as Catalog[Ref] small 1k with
  Ref : text
  Category : number
  SubCategory : number
  BuyPrice : number
  SellPrice : number

read "/Clean/LongTermPlanning/Forecast.ion" as Forecast small 100k expect[Ref]  with
  "Month" as MonthF : month
  Ref : text
  Baseline : number

read form with
  GrowthGeneral: number
  GrowthCat1 : number
  GrowthCat2 : number
  GrowthCat3 : number
  GrowthCat4 : number
  GrowthCat5 : number

/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// # 0. Display
/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


show tabs "" a3h3 with
  "general" as "General Overview"
  "category" as "Category View"


/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// # 1. Creation of the Slicing
/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

table Category = by Catalog.Category
Category.Category = same(Catalog.Category)

table SliceParameters = extend.range(11 * 7^5)

SliceParameters.GeneralChoice = SliceParameters.N mod 11
SliceParameters.ChoiceCat1 = (SliceParameters.N - floor(SliceParameters.N/11)) mod 7
SliceParameters.ChoiceCat2 = (SliceParameters.N - floor(SliceParameters.N/11/7)) mod 7
SliceParameters.ChoiceCat3 = (SliceParameters.N - floor(SliceParameters.N/11/7^2)) mod 7
SliceParameters.ChoiceCat4 = (SliceParameters.N - floor(SliceParameters.N/11/7^3)) mod 7
SliceParameters.ChoiceCat5 = (SliceParameters.N - floor(SliceParameters.N/11/7^4)) mod 7

table Slices[slice] small 200k = slice by [SliceParameters.N] title: text(SliceParameters.N)

Catalog.Extend = 11 * 7^5
Category.Extend = 11 * 7^5
table CatalogExtend = extend.range(Catalog.Extend)
keep where CatalogExtend.slice = same(SliceParameters.slice) by SliceParameters.N at CatalogExtend.N

table CategoryExtend = extend.range(Category.Extend)
keep where CategoryExtend.slice = same(SliceParameters.slice) by SliceParameters.N at CategoryExtend.N
CategoryExtend.Category = Category.Category

/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// # 2. Impact of the parametrization
/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SliceParameters.GeneralGrowth = match SliceParameters.GeneralChoice with
  0 -> -0.05
  1 -> -0.02
  2 -> -0.01
  3 -> 0
  4 -> 0.005
  5 -> 0.01
  6 -> 0.02
  7 -> 0.03
  8 -> 0.05
  9 -> 0.075
  10 -> 0.1

def pure PonderationScale(Pond: number) with
  Res = match Pond with
    0 -> 75
    1 -> 90
    2 -> 95
    3 -> 100
    4 -> 105
    5 -> 110
    6 -> 125
  return(Res)

Category.CurrentCA = sum(Forecast.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice)
Category.CAExpected = (if Category.Category == 1 then GrowthCat1 else if Category.Category == 2 then GrowthCat2 else if Category.Category == 3 then GrowthCat3 else if Category.Category == 4 then GrowthCat4 else GrowthCat5)
                       * Category.CurrentCA
CategoryExtend.CAExpected = Category.CAExpected

[Script (82169): General Vision V1 | Path: /5. Long Term Planning Module/Archive/General Vision V1]
[Reads: Catalog.ion]
[Reads: Forecast.ion]

Category.CurrentCA = sum(Forecast.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice)
Category.CAExpected = (if Category.Category == 1 then GrowthCat1 else if Category.Category == 2 then GrowthCat2 else if Category.Category == 3 then GrowthCat3 else if Category.Category == 4 then GrowthCat4 else GrowthCat5)
                       * Category.CurrentCA
CategoryExtend.CAExpected = Category.CAExpected

CategoryExtend.Ponderation = if CategoryExtend.Category == 1 then single(PonderationScale(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat1)) by slice else
                             if CategoryExtend.Category == 2 then single(PonderationScale(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat2)) by slice else
                             if CategoryExtend.Category == 3 then single(PonderationScale(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat3)) by slice else
                             if CategoryExtend.Category == 4 then single(PonderationScale(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat4)) by slice else
                             single(PonderationScale(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat5)) by slice

CategoryExtend.FullPonderation = if Category.CAExpected != 0 then 0 else Category.CurrentCA*CategoryExtend.Ponderation
SliceParameters.TotalPonderation = sum(CategoryExtend.FullPonderation) by slice

CurrentCA = sum(Forecast.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice)
SliceParameters.CATotalTarget = CurrentCA * (1+SliceParameters.GeneralGrowth)
SliceParameters.RemainingCA = SliceParameters.CATotalTarget - sum(CategoryExtend.CAExpected) by slice

CategoryExtend.FinalCA = CategoryExtend.CAExpected + CategoryExtend.FullPonderation * single(SliceParameters.RemainingCA/SliceParameters.TotalPonderation) by slice
SliceParameters.GrowthCat1 = single(CategoryExtend.FinalCA/Category.CurrentCA -1) by slice when (Category.Category == 1)
SliceParameters.GrowthCat2 = single(CategoryExtend.FinalCA/Category.CurrentCA -1) by slice when (Category.Category == 2)
SliceParameters.GrowthCat3 = single(CategoryExtend.FinalCA/Category.CurrentCA -1) by slice when (Category.Category == 3)
SliceParameters.GrowthCat4 = single(CategoryExtend.FinalCA/Category.CurrentCA -1) by slice when (Category.Category == 4)
SliceParameters.GrowthCat5 = single(CategoryExtend.FinalCA/Category.CurrentCA -1) by slice when (Category.Category == 5)

show slicepicker "Growth Target" f4h9  with
  same(SliceParameters.GeneralGrowth) as "General Growth Target" {numbers: percent}
  same(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat1) as "Growth Target - Cat. 1" {numbers: percent}
  same(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat2) as "Growth Target - Cat. 2" {numbers: percent}
  same(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat3) as "Growth Target - Cat. 3" {numbers: percent}
  same(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat4) as "Growth Target - Cat. 4" {numbers: percent}
  same(SliceParameters.ChoiceCat5) as "Growth Target - Cat. 5" {numbers: percent}


/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// # 3. Forecast Visualization
/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CatalogExtend.Growth = single(CategoryExtend.FinalCA) by [CategoryExtend.slice, CategoryExtend.Category] at [CatalogExtend.slice, Catalog.Category] /Category.CurrentCA

table CatalogExtendMonth = extend.range(CatalogExtend.12)
CatalogExtendMonth.MonthF = month(2025,CatalogExtendMonth.N)
CatalogExtendMonth.Baseline = single(Forecast.Baseline) by [Forecast.Ref, Forecast.MonthF] at [Catalog.Ref, CatalogExtendMonth.MonthF]


show linechart "Sales Target - 2025" slices: CatalogExtend.slice {tileTab: "general"} with
  sum(CatalogExtendMonth.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice * CatalogExtend.Growth) when (Catalog.Category == 1) as "Cat. 1" {unit: "€"; seriesType: bar ;seriesStack: bar}
  sum(CatalogExtendMonth.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice * CatalogExtend.Growth) when (Catalog.Category == 2) as "Cat. 2" {unit: "€"; seriesType: bar ;seriesStack: bar}
  sum(CatalogExtendMonth.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice * CatalogExtend.Growth) when (Catalog.Category == 3) as "Cat. 3" {unit: "€"; seriesType: bar ;seriesStack: bar}

table Suppliers = by Items.Supplier

Suppliers.Supplier = same(Items.Supplier)
Suppliers.TotalQuantityPurchased = sum(PORecommendations.OrderQuantity) by Items.Supplier at Suppliers.Supplier
Suppliers.TotalAmountPurchased = sum(PORecommendations.InvestmentRequired) by Items.Supplier at Suppliers.Supplier

Suppliers.IsExportedAndDeleted = same(ExportSuppliers.IsToExport and ExportSuppliers.IsToDelete) by ExportSuppliers.Supplier at Suppliers.Supplier or
                                 same(ExportSuppliers.IsToMove and ExportSuppliers.IsToDelete) by ExportSuppliers.Supplier at Suppliers.Supplier or
                                 same(ExportSuppliers.IsToExport and ExportSuppliers.IsToMove) by ExportSuppliers.Supplier at Suppliers.Supplier

//## Supplier Export
Suppliers.IsAlreadyExported = (not(Suppliers.Supplier in ExportSuppliers.Supplier) and Suppliers.Supplier != supplierReintegrate)
                              and not resetDashboard // Has been exported/deleted in a previous run
Suppliers.IsSupplierToExport = (same(ExportSuppliers.IsToExport)  by ExportSuppliers.Supplier at Suppliers.Supplier or (exportAll and not moveAll and not Suppliers.IsAlreadyExported))
                                and not resetDashboard  and not Suppliers.IsExportedAndDeleted
Suppliers.IsSupplierToDelete = (same(ExportSuppliers.IsToDelete)  by ExportSuppliers.Supplier at Suppliers.Supplier) and not resetDashboard  and not Suppliers.IsExportedAndDeleted
Suppliers.IsSupplierToMove   = (same(ExportSuppliers.IsToMove)  by ExportSuppliers.Supplier at Suppliers.Supplier or (moveAll and not exportAll and not Suppliers.IsAlreadyExported)) and not resetDashboard  and not Suppliers.IsExportedAndDeleted

Suppliers.IsValidationPending = not Suppliers.IsSupplierToExport and not Suppliers.IsSupplierToDelete and not Suppliers.IsSupplierToMove and not Suppliers.IsAlreadyExported

show summary "General KPIs" a4d4 {textAlign: left ; backgroundColor: #(GP.ColorAlight) ; tileTab: #(currentTab)} with
  sum(Suppliers.TotalQuantityPurchased) as "Total Suggested Qty" {textBold: "true" ; unit: #(GP.pcsUnit)}
  sum(Suppliers.TotalQuantityPurchased) when Suppliers.IsValidationPending as "Remaining Qty to Validate" {textBold: "true" ; unit: #(GP.pcsUnit)}
  sum(Suppliers.TotalAmountPurchased) when Suppliers.IsValidationPending as "Remaining Amount" {textBold: "true" ; unit: #(GP.DcUnit)}
  count(Suppliers.IsValidationPending) when (Suppliers.TotalQuantityPurchased > 0) as "# Suppliers to validate" {textBold: "true"}

Items.OrderQuantity = same(PORecommendations.OrderQuantity)
Items.InvestmentRequired = same(PORecommendations.InvestmentRequired)
Items.CurrentFR = same(PORecommendations.CurrentFR)
Items.NewFR = same(PORecommendations.NewFR)

Items.ChangedQty =single(Validation.FinalQty)
Items.FinalQty = if (Items.ChangedQty > 0 and not resetDashboard) then Items.ChangedQty else Items.OrderQuantity

Items.Validated =  (single(Validation.Validated) or resetDashboard)
Items.IsToExport = Items.Validated and Suppliers.IsSupplierToExport

labelboxdisplay = if any(Items.IsToExport) then "fixed" else "hidden"
show label "https://go.lokad.com/DEMO/gateway/BigFiles/Browse/Download?hash=CB8060E2BF3726438529D2919C33EE3E&path=%2FImages%2Flogos&name=GreenPO.png" d13 {tileTab: #(currentTab);tilePlacement: #(labelboxdisplay)}

where Items.IsToExport
  show table "Purchase Orders already validated" a13c13 {backgroundColor: #(GP.blue) ; tileTab: #(currentTab)} with
    Items.Id
    Items.Supplier
    Items.StockOnHand as "StockOnHand"
    Items.StockOnOrder as "StockOnOrder"
    Items.FinalQty
    Items.CurrentFR as "CurrentFR"
    Items.NewFR as "NewFR"

  [|as SupplierIdStr |]
  where DeletedSuppliers.SupplierIdStr != supplierReintegrate or DeletedSuppliers.SupplierIdStr == ""
    [|DeletedSuppliers.SupplierIdStr|]
  where Suppliers.IsSupplierToDelete
    [|Suppliers.Supplier|]

keep where not (Suppliers.IsSupplierToExport or Suppliers.IsSupplierToDelete or Suppliers.IsSupplierToMove or Suppliers.IsAlreadyExported)

import "/1. utilities/Modules/Functions" as Functions
import "/1. utilities/Modules/Global Parameters" as Gp

read "/Clean/Locations.ion" as Locations[Loc] with
  Loc : text
  CarryingCostWeight : number

read "/Clean/Items.ion" as Skus[Sku unsafe] expect[Loc] with
  Sku : text
  Ref : text
  Loc : text
  Name : text
  Category : text
  SellPrice : number
  BuyPrice : number
  RedispatchCycle : number
  DispatchLT : number
  StockOnHand : number
  StockOnOrder : number
  LeadTime : number
  ImageUrl : text
  StartDate : date
  EndDate : date
  Supplier : text
  LotMultiplierDispatch : number
  IsClean : boolean

read "/Clean/Forecast/Periodic/WeeklyFc.ion" as ForecastSku expect[Sku, Date] with
  Sku : text
  "Monday" as Date : date
  DemandQty : number
  Cache : number
  IsPast : boolean
  FutureWeekRank : number
  Alpha : number
  Dispersion : number
  Baseline : number
  Demand : ranvar
  LowerBarTotal2 : number
  LowerBarTotal1 : number
  HighBarTotal2 : number
  HighBarTotal1 : number
  CumDemand : ranvar

read "/Clean/Simulation/ROP.ion" as ROP expect[Sku,Loc] with
  Sku : text
  Loc : text
  ROP : number

keep where Skus.Loc != "DC"

Skus.StockOnHand = 7*Skus.StockOnHand///Swann 22.02.2024 : aligned with https://go.lokad.com/DEMO/d/75854/ to get coherent story
Skus.StockOnHand = if Sku == "CT-110-MAN" then round(0.9*Skus.StockOnHand) else Skus.StockOnHand

table SkusDay = cross(Skus,Day)
SkusDay.Baseline = same(ForecastSku.Baseline) by [ForecastSku.Sku,ForecastSku.Date] at [SkusDay.Sku,monday(SkusDay.Date)]
SkusDay.Baseline = SkusDay.Baseline * 7///Swann 22.02.2024 : aligned with https://go.lokad.com/DEMO/d/75854/ to get coherent story
SkusDay.Baseline = SkusDay.Baseline /7 ///Weekly baseline into daily baseline
SkusDay.FutureWeekRank = same(ForecastSku.FutureWeekRank) by [ForecastSku.Sku,ForecastSku.Date] at [SkusDay.Sku,monday(SkusDay.Date)]
SkusDay.RedispatchCycleWeeks = 1
SkusDay.ForecastWeekAfter = same(SkusDay.Baseline) by [SkusDay.Sku,SkusDay.FutureWeekRank] at [SkusDay.Sku,SkusDay.FutureWeekRank+1]
keep where SkusDay.FutureWeekRank > 0 and SkusDay.FutureWeekRank <=12

SkusDay.DayRank = rankrev () by SkusDay.Sku scan -SkusDay.Date
Skus.DispatchLTDays = 7
Skus.ROP = same(ROP.ROP)

SkusDay.EOQ = ceiling(SkusDay.ForecastWeekAfter * SkusDay.RedispatchCycleWeeks* 7 ) ///Daily forecast -> weekly forecast
SkusDay.StockOnHand = round(Skus.StockOnHand/2)
SkusDay.StockOnHand = if SkusDay.DayRank == 1 then SkusDay.StockOnHand else 0

SkusDay.StockEvolOnHand,SkusDay.StockEvolOnOrder,SkusDay.OrderedQty,SkusDay.StockDelivered =
  Functions.PurchaseQty(SkusDay.Baseline,Skus.ROP,SkusDay.EOQ,Skus.DispatchLTDays,1,SkusDay.StockOnHand ) by Skus.Sku scan SkusDay.Date

show linechart "Ventes et Prévisions" a2e5   with
  round(sum(SkusDay.Baseline)) as "Prévisions" {seriesFan: 1 ; seriesType: bar ; seriesLegendRank: "1" ; color: #(Gp.ColorAdark)}

// 2023-02-20: Created by Lokad
// For more documentation, see https://docs.lokad.com/

///Stock evolution function ------------------------------------------------------
export def process StockEvol(
    demand:number, /// demand quantity in selected time interval
    desiredStockLvl: number,
    reorderCycle:number, /// POINT ON WHICH WE CAN REORDER=
    leadtime:number, /// leadtime time serie, the leadtime forecast might vary.
    startStockonhand: number) with /// StartStockOnHand

  keep isStart = false
  keep stockOnHand = 0
  keep stockOnOrder = 0
  keep newOrder = 0
  keep reorderCycleTime = 0
  keep process lagQty = sumlagged(number,number) //this shares the process to be able to call it several times
  keep process lagQtyPreDay = sumlagged(number,number) //this shares the process to be able to call it several times

  /// Only Define Start Stock Once
  if not isStart
    stockOnHand = startStockonhand
    isStart = true

  /// Define If today is an order-day
  reorderCycleTime = reorderCycleTime + 1
  isOrderday = reorderCycle == reorderCycleTime
  if isOrderday
    reorderCycleTime = 0
  isCurrentOrderDay = reorderCycleTime == 0 // (Somehos its not working just to say `if isOrderday`)

  /// Define the desired order Qty if it is an order day
  suggestedQty = if isCurrentOrderDay then max(desiredStockLvl - (stockOnHand + stockOnOrder), 0) else 0
  newOrder = suggestedQty

  //Fresh stock intake
  arrivingStock = lagQty // the arriving stock is equal to the lagged quantity
  arrivingStockPreDay = lagQtyPreDay // we will display the arrival one day earlier (just for highlighting purpose that the stock came but it is not available for the yet.)

  stockOnHand = max(stockOnHand - demand, 0) + arrivingStock // stock on hand is the current stock + the new arrival
  stockOnOrder = stockOnOrder - arrivingStock + newOrder // Stock on order is a snapshot from what is still on the way (deduct the quantities that arrived + new orders)

  // This lag function is a bit counter intuitive. Everytime it is called, the first number will be catapulted in the future (leadtime)
  oldLag = lagQty(newOrder, leadtime)
  pdLag = lagQtyPreDay(newOrder, leadtime -1)

  return (stockOnHand, stockOnOrder, arrivingStockPreDay, newOrder)

export def process PurchaseQty(
    /// consumption time serie, can be negative.
    consumption:number,
    /// reorder point time serie, the RP might vary
    RP:number,
    /// economic order qty time serie, whenever you reorder
    /// you go back to RP + EOQ, EOQ can vary.
    EOQ:number,
    /// Leadtime time serie, the Leadtime forecast might vary.
    Leadtime:number,

    LotMultiplier : number,

    /// stockonhand at the begining, same value everywhere,
    /// only used in the keep.
    /// --> should be used as parameter but can't make it work
    initialstockonhand:number) with
    /// initial on orders arrivals, it's a time serie, the arrival
    /// dates have been computed beforehand hence it's not isolated in the keep

  keep stockonhand = 0
  keep stockonorder = 0
  keep process laggedorderedqty = sumlagged(number,number) //this shares the process to be able to call it several times

  //Fresh stock intake
  laggedorderedqty_updated = laggedorderedqty //this is to update to check if stock ordered before is arriving today
  stockonhand = stockonhand + initialstockonhand + laggedorderedqty_updated
  stockonorder = stockonorder - laggedorderedqty_updated

  //Stock on Hand
  stockonhand = max(0,stockonhand - consumption)

  //OrderQty (will be lagged if > 0), we order when stockcover is <= to RP and go back to RP+EOQ
  orderedqty = if stockonhand + stockonorder <= RP then
        round(EOQ/LotMultiplier)*LotMultiplier
      else
        0

  laggedorderedqty_new = laggedorderedqty(orderedqty, Leadtime)

  //Update stockonorder
  stockonorder = stockonorder + orderedqty

  return (stockonhand, stockonorder, orderedqty, laggedorderedqty_new)

///# For Long Term Planning
export def pure GrowthMap(Choice: number) with
  Growth = match Choice with
    0 -> -0.2
    1 -> -0.1
    2 -> -0.05
    3 -> -0.03
    4 -> -0.02
    5 -> -0.01
    6 -> -0.005
    7 -> 0
    8 -> 0.005
    9 -> 0.01
    10 -> 0.015
    11 -> 0.02
    12 -> 0.03
    13 -> 0.04
    14 -> 0.05
    15 -> 0.075
    16 -> 0.1
    17 -> 0.15
    18 -> 0.2
    19 -> 0.25
    .. -> -1
  return(Growth)

  Brand : text
  Supplier : text
  StartDate : date
  EndDate : date
  StockOnHand : number

  BuyPrice : number
  SellPrice : number
  MOQ : number

read "/Clean/PricingRuleBased/CompetitorCatalog.ion"  as Competitor expect[Id] with
  "Ref" as Id : text
  SellPrice : number
read "/Clean/Orders.ion"  as Sales expect[Id, date] with
  OrderId : text
  "Ref" as Id : text
  Quantity : number
  "OrderDate" as date: date
  "LokadNetAmount" as NetAmount : number
read "/Clean/PricingRuleBased/Classeur1.xlsx" as Calendar expect[date] with
  date: date
read form with
  yes: boolean
  Category : text
read upload "PerimetreCategoryUpload" as PerimetreCategoryUpload with
  Category : text
  SelectedCategory : boolean
  PricePercentChange : number
  PricingCompetitorAlignment : number
  MinMargin : number
read upload "PerimetreItemsUpload" as PerimetreItemsUpload with
  Item : text
  SelectedItem : boolean
  PricePercentChange : number
  PricingCompetitorAlignment : number
  MinMargin : number

////Useful constants to be used

lastdate = max(Sales.date)
today = date(2022,12,31)
nbdaystoday = 365
nbweekstoday = floor(nbdaystoday/7)
currentyear = year(today)
lastyear = currentyear - 1
daysunit = " days"

show tabs "" a4h4  {textColor: "black"} with
  "Catalog"
  "PricingRules" as "Pricing Management"
  "GlobalResults" as "Results Global Scope"
  "CategoryResults" as "Results Category Level"
  "ItemResults" as "Results Item Level"

Items.IsFirst = Items.Id == "DS-204"
table Slices [slice] = slice by [not Items.IsFirst,Items.Id] title: Items.Id

show logo "" d1e2

show label "Pricing Rules" a3h3 {textAlign: center ; textBold: "true"}

Items.CompetitorSellPrice = same(Competitor.SellPrice)
Items.LastYearSalesQty = sum(Sales.Quantity) when (year(Sales.date) == lastyear)
Items.LastYearSales = sum(Sales.NetAmount) when (year(Sales.date) == lastyear)
Items.YTDSalesQty = sum(Sales.Quantity) when (year(Sales.date) == currentyear)
Items.YTDSales = sum(Sales.NetAmount) when (year(Sales.date) == currentyear)
Items.SaleTrend = (Items.YTDSalesQty-Items.LastYearSalesQty)/.(Items.LastYearSalesQty)
Items.GrowthColor = if Items.SaleTrend > 0 then Colors.colorValid else Colors.colorRed

Items.MarginRate = (Items.SellPrice - Items.BuyPrice)/Items.SellPrice
Items.DailySalesQty = Items.YTDSalesQty/nbdaystoday
Items.NbDaysInStock = round(Items.StockOnHand/.Items.DailySalesQty)

Items.PricingRecommendationEmoji,Items.PricingRecommendation = if Items.NbDaysInStock < 30 then (GP.EmoPos,"Increase Price") else \

[Imports: Global Parameters]
[Reads: Items.ion]
[Reads: Orders.ion]
[Reads: PO.ion]
[Reads: WeeklyFc.ion]
[... and 2 more dependencies]


  Lateness: sun = PO not late ; cloud = PO less than 15% late ; umbrella = PO less than 30% late ; lightning = PO more than 30% late

  Quantity: purchased quantity

  NetAmount: amount of the purchase order

  __Purchase Orders (x% late)__: shows all POs late for the selected supplier

  Same columns as in the "All Purchase Order Lines" table

  __Supplier LeadTimes (Days)__: shows selected supplier purchase orders leadtimes distribution

  __Weekly lateness of POs by order date__: for the selected supplier, proportion of purchase orders in every lateness status for every order date

  """

/// ------------------------------------- [ PRE-CALCULATION ] -----------------------------------

oend = max(Orders.date)
missingDate = date(2001,01,01)

table Focus[Code] = by Items.Focus
keep where PO.Code = same(Focus.Code) by Items.Focus

PO.NetAmount = PO.Quantity * Items.BuyPrice

Items.BuyValue365 = sum(PO.NetAmount) when (PO.date > oend - 365 )
Items.Quantity365 = sum(PO.Quantity) when (PO.date > oend - 365)
Focus.FocusBuyValue365 = sum(Items.BuyValue365)
Focus.FocusQuantity365 = sum(Items.Quantity365)

Focus.FocusBuyValue365label = concat("Purchased 365 d: ", text(Focus.FocusBuyValue365), DcUnit )

where PO.PONumber ~~ "PO-oonLab_201426" or PO.PONumber ~~ "PO-ergyLab_201929"
  PO.DeliveryDate = PO.DeliveryDate + 62
PO.Leadtime = PO.DeliveryDate - PO.date + 1

///Demo outliers
Items.PoLtRv = ranvar(PO.Leadtime) by Items.Supplier at Items.Supplier
Items.PoQ = quantile(Items.PoLtRv , 0.05)
Items.PoQmax = quantile(Items.PoLtRv , 0.95)

PO.RandomNumber = 0
where argwhichever() by PO.PONumber
  PO.RandomNumber = random.uniform(PO.0,PO.1)
PO.RandomNumber = same(PO.RandomNumber) when(PO.RandomNumber != 0) by PO.PONumber

PO.InitialDeliveryDate = PO.DeliveryDate
where PO.Leadtime < Items.PoQ
  PO.DeliveryDate = PO.date + Items.PoQmax + round(PO.RandomNumber * (Items.PoQmax/2))

PO.DeliveryDate = if PO.DeliveryDate > oend then missingDate else PO.DeliveryDate

PO.Leadtime = if PO.DeliveryDate != missingDate then PO.DeliveryDate - PO.date + 1 else 0
///End demo outliers

PO.LeadTimeTarget = ceiling(avg(PO.Leadtime) by PO.Supplier) + 2
PO.LeadTimeTarget = if PO.Supplier ~~ "MedicalExpert" then 31 else PO.LeadTimeTarget
PO.LeadTimeTarget = if PO.Supplier ~~ "AllergyLab" then 14 else PO.LeadTimeTarget

// keep where PO.Leadtime > 0

PO.Overtime =  max(PO.Leadtime - PO.LeadTimeTarget,0)
PO.IsLate = PO.Overtime >= 0.05

PO.Icon = if not PO.IsLate then "☀"
          else if PO.Overtime / PO.Leadtime < 0.15 then "☁"

PO.Overtime =  max(PO.Leadtime - PO.LeadTimeTarget,0)

PO.Icon = if not PO.IsLate then "☀"
          else if PO.Overtime / PO.Leadtime < 0.15 then "☁"
          else if PO.Overtime / PO.Leadtime < 0.30 then "☂"
          else "ϟ"
PO.IconText = concat(PO.Icon, if PO.Overtime == 0 then " On time"
              else if PO.Overtime == 1 then "1 day late"
              else " \{PO.Overtime} days late")

PO.MonthStart = monthStart(PO.date)

Focus.Lateness = round(ratio(PO.IsLate)*100)
Focus.Ranking = if Focus.Lateness < 10 then "⭐⭐⭐"
                else if Focus.Lateness < 20 then "⭐⭐"
                else if Focus.Lateness < 30 then "⭐"
                else "❌"

Focus.maxDate = max(PO.date)
where PO.date >= Focus.maxDate - 6*30
  Focus.Latenessold = ratio(PO.IsLate)
where PO.date >= Focus.maxDate -12* 30  and PO.date < Focus.maxDate - 6*30
  Focus.Latenessnew = ratio(PO.IsLate)

Focus.Tendency = if Focus.Latenessnew == 0 then 0 else (Focus.Latenessold - Focus.Latenessnew) /. Focus.Latenessnew
Focus.TendencyLabel = if Focus.Tendency > 0.1 then "↗ Increasing"
                      else if Focus.Tendency < -0.1 then "↘ Decreasing"
                      else "→ Stable"

table Slices [slice] = slice by [-Focus.FocusBuyValue365 , Focus.Code] title: Focus.Code subtitle: Focus.FocusBuyValue365label

table FocusMonth = cross(Focus, Month)
FocusMonth.FirstDay = date(month,1)
FocusMonth.Volume  = sum(PO.NetAmount)
FocusMonth.Slice = Focus.slice

PO.slice = Focus.slice
Items.slice = Focus.slice

  The company has concentrated its assortment on the high movers and introduced its own brand in the majority of available items.
  The company sources 80% of its references from suppliers across China and Taiwan, while the remainder is sourced domestically in the United States.
  Operations are carried out of a central warehouse located in Leicester, and three other Distribution Centers located in London, Manchester, and Edinburgh.

  Three initial decision scopes are proposed:

  1. Recommended purchase quantities at the DC level.
  2. Dispatch and inventory movements from Leicester to London, Manchester and Edinburgh.
  3. Recommended price adjustments at the DC level.

  The goal of the first scope will be an optimized list of recommended items and order quantities on a regular
  basis for purchasing. The goal of the second scope will be to ensure dispatch between the entire distribution
  network. The goal of the third scope will be to adjust the prices of the items based on their stock levels
  to optimise the return over investment in stockout or overstock situations.
  Lokad's deliverables will be online analysis and reporting dashboards in the LOKAD application and file exports that consolidate
  all decisions recommended by Lokad, consolidated documentation that goes in detail of all project elements

  explaining each decision at the micro and macro level.

show form "Optimization targets" a4b6 {tileTab: "Parameters" ; formButton: "Run" ; fieldColor: #D5ECBC}  with
  FRTarget as "Target Fill Rate (0-100%)"
  budgetTarget as "Budget Target ($)"

// Categories.AgressivenessFactorIni = match Categories.CategoryName with
//   "Wheel & tyre accessories" ->  min(max(agressivenessFactorCosmetic, 0), 5)
//   "Car Mats" ->  min(max(agressivenessFactorMedicalSupplies, 0), 5)

//   "Charging Accessories" ->  min(max(agressivenessFactorDrugs, 0), 5)
//   "Brakes" ->  min(max(agressivenessFactorDrugs, 0), 5)

Categories.AgressivenessFactorIni = match Categories.CategoryName with
  "Cosmetic" ->  min(max(agressivenessFactorCosmetic, 0), 5)
  "Medical Supplies" ->  min(max(agressivenessFactorMedicalSupplies, 0), 5)

Items.SupplierLTWeeks = ceiling(Items.LeadTime / 7)

Items.SatisfiedDemand = single(DemandDistributions.SatisfiedDemand)
Items.TotalDemandRLT = single(DemandDistributions.TotalDemandRLT)
Items.TotalDemandRLTDisplay = single(DemandDistributions.TotalDemandRLTDisplay)
Items.HoldingTime = single(DemandDistributions.HoldingTime)

Items.FR = fillrate(Items.TotalDemandRLT)
Items.CurrentFR = int(Items.FR, 0, Items.SatisfiedDemand)

///Score
Items.SellThrough = (1 - cdf(Items.SatisfiableDemand + 1)) * uniform.right(1) //values in negative are not relevant

Items.RwdM = Items.SellThrough * Items.M

///Score
Items.SellThrough = (1 - cdf(Items.SatisfiableDemand + 1)) * uniform.right(1) //values in negative are not relevant

Items.RwdM = Items.SellThrough * Items.M
Items.RwdS = - Items.SellThrough * Items.S
Items.RwdC = Items.HoldingTime * Items.C

Items.Reward = Items.RwdM + Items.RwdS - Items.RwdC

Grid.M = int(Items.RwdM, Grid.Min, Grid.Max)
Grid.S = int(Items.RwdS, Grid.Min, Grid.Max)
Grid.C = int(Items.RwdC, Grid.Min, Grid.Max)
Grid.Reward = int(Items.Reward, Grid.Min, Grid.Max)

Grid.Cost = Grid.Q * Items.BuyPrice

Grid.Score = Grid.Reward /. Grid.Cost


///Eligible decision
    ///Purchase decision
    //3 categories agressiveness factors = 1-1-1 --> 87% overall fill rate
    //3 categories agressiveness factors = 3-4-5 --> 92% overall fill rate
    //3 categories agressiveness factors = 5-5-5 --> 99% overall fill rate
where date >= oend - 365 and date <= oend
  Items.LastYearSales = sum(Orders.LokadNetAmount)
  lastYearOverallSales = sum(Orders.LokadNetAmount)
  Items.SalesWeight = Items.LastYearSales / lastYearOverallSales
  currentFR = sum(Items.CurrentFR * Items.SalesWeight)
  Items.SupplierLastYearSales = sum(Orders.LokadNetAmount) by Items.Supplier at Items.Supplier

  Items.SupplierSalesWeight = Items.LastYearSales / Items.SupplierLastYearSales

Grid.CumInvest = 0
Grid.IsEligible = false
where Grid.Min > 0
//Ranking potential purchases accoring to the score
  Grid.Rank = rank(Grid.Score, Id, -Grid.Max)

  Grid.CumInvest = sum(Grid.Cost) scan Grid.Rank
  Grid.CumFillrateDelta = sum(Grid.FillRateDelta) by Items.Id scan Grid.Rank

  Grid.OverallFRGain = Grid.FillRateDelta * Items.SalesWeight
  Grid.CumOverallFRGain = sum(Grid.OverallFRGain) scan Grid.Rank

  Grid.IsEligible = FRTarget - currentFR > 0 and
                    Grid.CumOverallFRGain <= FRTarget - currentFR and
                    Grid.CumInvest < budgetTarget
  ///Basile: classic global FRTarget instead of target that is function of agressivity at category level. Asked by Fabian and Swann on 31/01/2024
  // Grid.IsEligible = Items.CategoryFRTarget - Items.CategoryCurrentFR > 0 and
  //                   Grid.CumCategoryFRGain <= Items.CategoryFRTarget - Items.CategoryCurrentFR

  where Grid.IsEligible
    Items.OrderQuantity = sum(Grid.Q)
    Items.ExpectedROI = sum(Grid.Reward) / sum(Grid.Investment)

Items.FR = same(PORecommendations.FR)
Items.SatisfiedDemand = same(DemandDistributions.SatisfiedDemand)
Items.NewFR = min(int(Items.FR, 0, Items.SatisfiedDemand + Items.OrderQuantity), max(Items.CurrentFR,0.999))

Items.InvestmentRequired = Items.OrderQuantity * Items.BuyPrice

investmentRequired = sum(Items.InvestmentRequired)
show scalar "Total Investments" c4 {textBold: "true" ; textAlign: center ; tileTab: "Results"} with
  investmentRequired as "" {unit: #(DcUnit)}

show scalar "Current Fill Rate" a4 {textBold: "true" ; textAlign: center ; tileTab: "Results"} with
  currentFR as "" {numbers: percent}

achievedFR = sum(Items.NewFR * Items.SalesWeight)

Leadtime: supplier leadtime in days

Buy price: raw purchase price from the supplier

Sell price: raw sell price

Margin: raw margin, i.e. difference between sell price and buy price

StockOnHand: reference current stock on hand

StockOnOrder: reference current stock on order, i.e. units purchased but not delivered yet

Avg SLT Demand: average forecasted demand on the next supplier leadtime

Avg WOO Demand: average forecasted demand on the next responsibility window (WOO), i.e. a reorder cycle period in a supplier leadtime

Avg Total Demand: average total demand on a supplier leadtime + a responsibility window (or reorder cycle)

Sugg. Order Quantity: recommended purchase quantity to cover the next responsibility window

Investment: investment associated to the recommended purchase quantity

Contrib. to overall Fillrate reference contribution to overall fill rate

__Category x Purchase suggestions__: all references of Category x to buy and main indicators to understand the purchase recommendations. Category x can be choosen in
the filter on the top right corner of the dashboard

__All Suppliers Micro decisions__: all units of every reference to buy prioritized by decreasing order of return on investment

Rank: unit rank of all units of all reference by decreasing order of return on investment (the lower the rank of the unit, the higher its return on investment)

FillRate Δ: additional fill rate brought by the micro decision line purchase, i.e. by a single unit purchase

Exp. Margin: expected gross margin of the given unit

Exp. Stockout Cover: expected stock out penalty covered by the given unit

Exp. Carrying Costs: expected carrying cost of the given unit

Tot. Reward: total reward. Equals to Exp. Margin + Exp. Stockout Cover - Exp. Carrying Costs

ROI: return on investment. Equals to Tot. Reward / Buy price

Cum. Invest.: investment needed to buy the basket

Is Purchased?: for a given reference, all units recommended for purchase are set to "yes", the others to "no"

Sugg. Order Quantity: recommended purchase quantity to cover the next responsibility window

Investment: investment associated to the recommended purchase quantity

Contrib. to overall Fillrate reference contribution to overall fill rate

__Category x Purchase suggestions__: all references of Category x to buy and main indicators to understand the purchase recommendations. Category x can be choosen in
the filter on the top right corner of the dashboard

__All Suppliers Micro decisions__: all units of every reference to buy prioritized by decreasing order of return on investment

Rank: unit rank of all units of all reference by decreasing order of return on investment (the lower the rank of the unit, the higher its return on investment)

FillRate Δ: additional fill rate brought by the micro decision line purchase, i.e. by a single unit purchase

Exp. Margin: expected gross margin of the given unit

Exp. Stockout Cover: expected stock out penalty covered by the given unit

Exp. Carrying Costs: expected carrying cost of the given unit

Tot. Reward: total reward. Equals to Exp. Margin + Exp. Stockout Cover - Exp. Carrying Costs

ROI: return on investment. Equals to Tot. Reward / Buy price

Cum. Invest.: investment needed to buy the basket

Is Purchased?: for a given reference, all units recommended for purchase are set to "yes", the others to "no"

To perform this dispatch optimization, we compute for each dispatchable unit, whether it is more profitable
to send it to 1 of the 2 downstream location of to keep it in DC. In order to do that, we virtually empty the stock in DC and then, for each unit
compute the reward of putting it back in DC or sending it to EDB, MAN and LON.

The micro decisions represent the status of each of these decisions so, in this table, the currentFR in DC is the FR without StockOnHand (ie 0 if there is no StockOnOrder).

`Rank`: Order of the micro decisions (sorted by descending Score).

`StockOnHand`: Stock on hand before dispatch in the location.

`LotMultiplier`: numbers of pcs by which we can dispatch the Sku (for one ref, can change depending on the location).

`Min`: rank of the 1st unit dispatched with this decision.

`Max`: rank of the last unit dispatched with this decision.

`Q`: quantity we are considering dispatching for this decision (1 if no specific constraint, more if LotMultiplier or MOQ). Equal to Max-Min+1.

`Transportation LT`: time it takes for a unit to be available in the destination location from the moment the dispatch decision is taken. It includes loading and unloading the truck and the time of the drive.

`CurrentFR`: Sku's FR before dispatch.

`FillRateDelta`: Sku's FR gain if the decision is selected.

`CumFillRateDelta`: Sku's FR gain if the decision and the previous ones are selected.

`OverallFRGain`: Overall FR gain if the decision is selected.

`CumOverallFRGain`: Overall FR gain if the decision and all the possible previous possible decisions are selected.

`CumStockDispatchedByRef`: Quantity dispatched by Sku if the decision and the previous ones are selected.

`NewFR EDB/MAN/LON`: FR in EDB/MAN/LON if the decision and all the possible previous possible decisions are selected.

`FR target by location`: Maximum FR reachable for each location (manual input, forced to 100% for DC).

where (not WeeklyFC.IsPast) or WeeklyFC.date == oend //currentWeek defined as past in preprocessing
                                                     //for dispatch we take it into account as we can have a 0 weeks LT
  WeeklyFC.TimeIndex = (rankrev () by WeeklyFC.Sku scan -WeeklyFC.date) - 1 //start rank at 0, needed for 0 weeks LT

  ///Satisfiable demand and Holding time
  Skus.SatisfiableDemand, Skus.HoldingTime = actionrwd.reward(
    TimeIndex: WeeklyFC.TimeIndex,
    Baseline: WeeklyFC.Baseline,
    Dispersion: Skus.Dispersion,
    Alpha: Skus.Alpha,
    StockOnHand: Skus.StockAvailable,
    StockOnOrder : PO.Quantity,
    ArrivalTime : poisson(ceiling(PO.ArrivalTime)), //dirac(0) --> considered as stock on hand, error if < 0
    LeadTime: poisson(Skus.DispatchLTWeeks),
    StepOfReorder: Skus.RedispatchCycleWeeks,
    Samples: trajectoryCount,
    Seed: 1)

  //Rwd
  Skus.StockLeftEndDispatchLT = max(0, -Skus.SatisfiableDemand)

  //Fillrate
  // Skus.MeanPriorDemand = mean(Skus.DemandOLT)
  Skus.MeanPriorDemand = sum(WeeklyFC.Baseline)
                        when (WeeklyFC.TimeIndex >= Skus.DispatchLTWeeks and
                        WeeklyFC.TimeIndex < Skus.DispatchLTWeeks + Skus.RedispatchCycleWeeks)

  Skus.SatisfiedDemand = round(max(0, Skus.MeanPriorDemand - mean(Skus.SatisfiableDemand))) //Demand satisfied by the available stock by the end of t + SLT. Just for
  Skus.TotalDemand = Skus.SatisfiableDemand + Skus.SatisfiedDemand // All these offset

  WeeklyFC.CumDemand = actionrwd.demand(
    TimeIndex: WeeklyFC.TimeIndex,
    BaseLine: WeeklyFC.Baseline,
    Dispersion: Skus.Dispersion,
    Alpha: Skus.Alpha)

  WeeklyFC.PreviousCumDemand = same(WeeklyFC.CumDemand)
                                when(WeeklyFC.TimeIndex != 0)
                                by [WeeklyFC.Sku, WeeklyFC.TimeIndex]
                                at [WeeklyFC.Sku, WeeklyFC.TimeIndex - 1]

  ///Satisfied demand
  Skus.AvgDemandOnRLT = sum(WeeklyFC.Baseline)
                          when(WeeklyFC.TimeIndex >= Skus.DispatchLTWeeks and WeeklyFC.TimeIndex < Skus.TotalLTWeeks)
  Skus.SatisfiedDemand = max(round(Skus.AvgDemandOnRLT - mean(Skus.SatisfiableDemand)),0) //is this max relevant ?

  ///New all RLT demand rebuilt
  Skus.TotalDemandRLT = Skus.SatisfiableDemand + dirac(Skus.SatisfiedDemand)

  ///Sell through

  Skus.SellThrough = (1 - cdf(Skus.SatisfiableDemand + 1)) * uniform.right(1) //values in negative are not relevant

  The methodology to calculate the needs on the responsibility window is described below.

  __Step 1 - Stock End SLT__

  Lokad's calculates the stock at the beginning of the responsibility window, i.e. the stock at the end of the next supplier leadtime. To do
  so, it starts at the current stock on hand, adds all purchase orders which will arrive durring the supplier leadtime and substracts all demands on the supplier leadtime.
  In this example, the size of the supplier lead time is assumed to be fixed.

  __Step 2 - Current FR on responsibility window (WOO)__

  Lokad's makes an estimation of the demand on the responsibility window. Then, it deduces the uncovered demand on the responsibility by substracting the stock at the end
  of the supplier leadtime to the demand on the responsibility window. Lokad's is also able to calculate the current fill rate on the responsibility window, i.e. the proportion
  of the demand on the responsibility window which is covered by the stock at the end of the supplier leadtime. In reality we use a probabilistic supplier lead time for the calculation
  but this makes the interpretability of the data even more challenging.

  __Step 3 - Fill rate target and final recommendation__

  Depending on the agressiveness factor chosen by the user, the economic prioritization aims a specific fill rate target and then, a specific quantity needed to cover the responsibility window.
  The final purchase recommendation is calculated as the difference between this quantity needed to cover the responsibility window and the stock which will already be there at the end of the
  supplier leadtime.

  """

//Stock evo function gives the stock at the end of a week

//WeeklyFc.FutureWeekRank = 0 is the first week

Items.LastPOArrivalQty = same(ItemsWeek.ReceivedQty) when ItemsWeek.IsLastPastWeek
// Items.LastForecast = same(WeeklyFc.ReplicateDemand) //there is no forecast in last past week, so this should always be 0. Replaced by last demand
Items.LastDemand = same(WeeklyFc.DemandQty) when  WeeklyFc.IsLastPastWeek
Items.LastStockEndWeek = max(Items.LastStockOnHand + Items.LastPOArrivalQty - Items.LastDemand, 0)

//Several scenario: very high, high, avg, low, very low
//The quantiles value so that we have a nice spread over time and to avoid calling another actionrwd function

ItemsWeek.Demand = if ItemsWeek.Baseline > 0 then negativeBinomial(ItemsWeek.Baseline,Items.Dispersion) else dirac(0)

/// TEST Stock dev simulation options
import "/1. utilities/Modules/Functions" as Functions with
  StockEvol
import "/1. utilities/Modules/Global Parameters" as GP with
  onHandColor
  arrivingColor
  newOrderColor
  onOrderColor
  realDemand

read "/Input/Catalog/Catalog*" unsafe as Items [Id unsafe] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  "Ref" as Ref : text
  Name : text
  Loc : text
  Supplier : text
  Category : text
  InternalStockAggressiveness : number
  IsTopItem : boolean
  StartDate : date
  EndDate : date

read "/Input/Orders/Orders*" unsafe as History expect[Id, date] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  "Ref" as Ref : text
  Loc : text
  "OrderDate" as date: date
  "Quantity" as DayQty : number
  NetAmount : number
  Currency : text
  OrderId : text

read "/Manual/Suppliers_Dashboard.ion" as Supplier with
  Supplier : text
  LeadTime : number
  "Order Frequency" as ReorderCycle : number

table ItemsWeek = cross(Items, Week)

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
///--------------------------------------PREPROCESS-----------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

ItemsWeek.WeekDate = min(monday(date)) into Week

History.Mday = monday(History.date)
History.WkQty = sum(History.DayQty) by [Id, History.Mday]

Items.MinHistory = min(History.date)
Items.MaxHistory = max(History.date)

maxHistory = max(History.date)

///Slice------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
table Slices [slice] = slice by [not Items.IsTopItem, Items.Id] title: Items.Id subtitle: "ItemName \{Items.Name}"

History.slice = Items.slice
ItemsWeek.slice = Items.slice

///Leadtimes--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

keep where argwhichever() by [Id, History.Mday]

///Reorder cycle
Items.ReorderCycle = same(Supplier.ReorderCycle) by Supplier.Supplier at Items.Supplier
History.ReorderCycleDays = Items.ReorderCycle
History.ReorderCycleWeeks = ceiling(History.ReorderCycleDays / 7)

///Supplier leadtime

//Raw SLT
Items.RawSupplierLTDays = max(Supplier.LeadTime) by Supplier.Supplier at Items.Supplier default 1

//Randomize SLT
seed1 = 2421
seed2 = 3547
History.BaseLT = Items.RawSupplierLTDays
History.DiffLT = ceiling(History.BaseLT / 10)
History.RdnSupplierLTDays = max(History.BaseLT +
                                round((random.uniform(History.0,History.1)) * History.DiffLT)
                              - round((random.uniform(History.0,History.1)) * History.DiffLT) , 7)

History.SupplierLTDays = History.RdnSupplierLTDays
History.SupplierLTWeeks = ceiling(History.SupplierLTDays / 7)

///Total leadtime
Items.TotalLTWeeks = ceiling((Items.RawSupplierLTDays + Items.ReorderCycle) / 7)

///For some items, create a lower stock on hand so that we can have more interesting results in the dispatch simulation
Items.IsDispatchStock = random.uniform(Items.0,Items.1) < 0.25 and Items.Loc != "MAN" //don't decrease stock for 1 loc, to show what happens in dispatch if there is 1 well stocked loc

Items.TotalLTWeeks = ceiling((Items.RawSupplierLTDays + Items.ReorderCycle) / 7)

///For some items, create a lower stock on hand so that we can have more interesting results in the dispatch simulation
Items.IsDispatchStock = random.uniform(Items.0,Items.1) < 0.25 and Items.Loc != "MAN" //don't decrease stock for 1 loc, to show what happens in dispatch if there is 1 well stocked loc

///Desired stock level simulation: sales moving average-------------------------------------

///Sales moving average
where argwhichever() by [Id, History.Mday]

  ///Ideal stock
  ItemsWeek.WkQty = same(History.WkQty) by [Id, History.Mday] at [ItemsWeek.Id, ItemsWeek.WeekDate]

  Items.SecurityStockWeeks = if Items.Id == "CT-111-DC" or Items.Id == "CT-112-DC" then 0 else
                                 if not Items.IsTopItem then 6 else 4

  Items.SafetyTotalLTWeeks = if Items.IsDispatchStock and Items.Id != "CT-111-DC" and Items.Id != "CT-112-DC" then 3
                             else Items.TotalLTWeeks + Items.SecurityStockWeeks

  ItemsWeek.MovingAvgFuture = sum(ItemsWeek.WkQty) by ItemsWeek.Id over week = [0 .. Items.SafetyTotalLTWeeks]
  ItemsWeek.LYMovingAvgFuture = ItemsWeek.MovingAvgFuture[-52]

  Items.MaxWeek = max(ItemsWeek.WeekDate)
  Items.AvgMovingAvgFuture = avg(ItemsWeek.MovingAvgFuture)
                              when(ItemsWeek.WeekDate > Items.StartDate and
                              ItemsWeek.WeekDate < Items.MaxWeek - Items.SafetyTotalLTWeeks * 7)
                              default avg(ItemsWeek.MovingAvgFuture)
                              when(ItemsWeek.MovingAvgFuture != 0)

  ItemsWeek.MovingAvgFuture = if ItemsWeek.WeekDate >= Items.MaxWeek - Items.SafetyTotalLTWeeks * 7 then
                                if ItemsWeek.WeekDate - 365 >= Items.StartDate then ItemsWeek.LYMovingAvgFuture else Items.AvgMovingAvgFuture
                              else ItemsWeek.MovingAvgFuture

  ItemsWeek.IdealStock = ceiling(ItemsWeek.MovingAvgFuture) //* Items.InternalStockAggressiveness)

  ///Start stock
  Items.MinWeek = min(ItemsWeek.WeekDate)
  Items.StartStock = same(ItemsWeek.MovingAvgFuture) when(ItemsWeek.WeekDate == Items.MinWeek)

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~


///Stock evolution function call----------------------------------------------------------
History.MyStockOnHand,\
History.MyStockOnOrder,\
History.MyStockArriving,\
History.MyNewOrder  =

StockEvol(History.WkQty,
          ItemsWeek.IdealStock,
          History.ReorderCycleWeeks,
          History.SupplierLTWeeks,
          Items.StartStock)
          by History.Id
          scan History.Mday

  History.MyStockOnHand

  History.MyStockArriving


///Post Process-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

History.MyStockOnOrder = round(History.MyStockOnOrder,0)
History.MyStockArriving = round(History.MyStockArriving,0)

Items.SupShort = substr(Items.Supplier,3)

History.PONumber = concat("PO-",Items.SupShort,"_",History.OrderWeek)

stockEnd = max(History.Mday)

    ManualPO.Quantity = 26
  where Items.Id == "CT-111-DC"

History.CurrentOnHand = History.MyStockOnHand + History.MyStockArriving

History.ManualCurrentOnOrder = same(ManualPO.Quantity) by Items.Id at History.Id

History.MaxSkuOrderDate = maxHistory + 1
History.IsLatestArrival = false
where History.MyNewOrder > 0 and History.Mday <= maxHistory - Items.ReorderCycle
  History.MaxSkuOrderDate = max(History.Mday) by Id
  History.IsLatestArrival = History.Mday == History.MaxSkuOrderDate

where History.Mday >= History.MaxSkuOrderDate
  History.MyNewOrder = floor(History.MyNewOrder / 2)
  History.MyStockOnOrder = floor(History.MyStockOnOrder / 2)

def const pure SlicingKey (N: number, Slicer: number, defaultArg: text, Arg: text) with
  reste = N - floor(N/(2^Slicer))
  key = if reste mod 2 == 0 then concat("1 - ", defaultArg) else concat("2 - ", Arg)
  return key

def const pure SlicingName (Arg: text) with
  prefixe = field(Arg," - ",0)
  suffixe = field(Arg," - ",1)
  return(if prefixe == "1" then "" else concat(suffixe," x "))

table CatalogExtend = extend.range(Catalog.32)  /// 2^nb_dim * nb_horizons (2/4/6/12 months)
CatalogExtend.N = CatalogExtend.N - 1

CatalogExtend.Category = SlicingKey(CatalogExtend.N, 1, "All Categories", concat("Category ",Catalog.Category))
CatalogExtend.Section = SlicingKey(CatalogExtend.N, 2, "All Sections", concat("Section ",Catalog.SubCategory))
CatalogExtend.Supplier = SlicingKey(CatalogExtend.N, 3, "All Suppliers", Catalog.Supplier)

CatalogExtend.NbMonth = if CatalogExtend.N < 8 then 2 else
                        if CatalogExtend.N < 16 then 4 else
                        if CatalogExtend.N < 24 then 6
                        else 12

CatalogExtend.Slicer = concat(CatalogExtend.Category," x ",CatalogExtend.Section," x ",CatalogExtend.Supplier," x ",CatalogExtend.NbMonth)

table Slices [slice] = slice by CatalogExtend.Slicer title: CatalogExtend.Slicer

show slicepicker "Aggregation Choice" a4b7  with
  same(CatalogExtend.Category) as "Category" {sliceHierarchy: ask}
  same(CatalogExtend.Section) as "Section" {sliceHierarchy: ask}
  same(CatalogExtend.Supplier) as "Supplier" {sliceHierarchy: ask}
  same(CatalogExtend.NbMonth) as "Duration of the Purchase Horizon" {sliceHierarchy: ask ; unit: " months"}

Slices.NameSlice = if same(CatalogExtend.N) mod 16 == 0 or same(CatalogExtend.N) mod 16 == 15 then "All Scope"
                   else same(field(concat(SlicingName(CatalogExtend.Category), SlicingName(CatalogExtend.Section), SlicingName(CatalogExtend.Supplier),"END")," x END",0))
Slices.Duration = same(concat(CatalogExtend.NbMonth, " months horizon"))

/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
///# 2. Forecast
/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

///## A] Looking at data parametrized at Category and Global level

Catalog.CatGrowthReason = if same(GeneralParametrisation.IsCatForcedHighLevel) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Catalog.Category then "Forced at High Level" else
                          if same(GeneralParametrisation.IsCatForced) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Catalog.Category then "Forced at Category Level"
                          else "Adjustment with respect general growth"
Catalog.SectionGrowthReason = if same(CategoryParametrisation.IsForcedSub) by [CategoryParametrisation.Category, CategoryParametrisation.SubCategory] at [Catalog.Category, Catalog.SubCategory] then "Forced at Category Level"
                              else "Adjustment with respect to category growth"

Catalog.Growth = same(CategoryParametrisation.GrowthSub) by [CategoryParametrisation.Category, CategoryParametrisation.SubCategory] at [Catalog.Category, Catalog.SubCategory]
Catalog.CA = sum(Forecast.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice)

show table  "List of Growth by Reference - \{Slices.NameSlice}" a18h18 slices: CatalogExtend.slice {tileTab: "forecast" ; tileColor: #(highlightColor)} with
  Catalog.Ref into CatalogExtend as "Ref"
  concat("Category ",Catalog.Category) as "Category"

  For **Sku dependent inputs**, we here enable to modify:
  - Buy Price
  - Sell Price
  - Stock On Hand
  - Lot Multiplier
  - Lot Multiplier Dispatch
  - MOQ
  - LeadTime (ie Supplier Lead Time)
  - Reorder Cycle
  - ReDispatch Cycle

  In a real word use case, it doesn't make sense to manually modify values such as the Stock, this is only enabled here
  so that user can easily compare the behaviour of the optimizations in different cases.

  There is also a column called CopyDemandOfLoc. This is a way to copy the demand of another location for a given Sku
  so that users can see how other parameters affect the final suggestions in the same demand conditions. The expected input
  is one of the 4 location codes.

  It is also possible to modify the **carrying cost weight** of each Location.
  The carryingCost is an economic force modelled by Lokad and used in the optimizations. It represents the storage cost
  of each item per unit of time. The carrying cost weight enables the user to adjust the storage cost in each Location
  comparatively to the base situation compared by Lokad. A weight of 1 means that the cost considered is still the default value,
  a weight of 1.5 means that the cost is increased of 50% at this location.

  The purpose of this feature is to see how the system reacts to higher storage costs that companies can face in an FBA warehouse for instance.
  It is strongly discouraged to input a weight of 0 or very close to 0.

  **Warning**:

  1. If any value entered doesn't make sense (negative stock, price, leadtime...) the dashboard will fail and no modification will be exported

///Stock end week function
def process StockEndWeek(
    demand:number, /// demand quantity in selected time interval
    startStockOnHand: number,
    arrivalQty: number,
    forecastNextReorder : number,
    timeIndex : number,
    isLastPastWeek : boolean) with /// Define if the stocklevel can fall below 0 (= BackOrders)
  keep StockOnHand = 0

  if timeIndex == 0
    StockOnHand = 0
  if isLastPastWeek
    StockOnHand = startStockOnHand
  if timeIndex >= 1
    StockOnHand = max(max(StockOnHand + arrivalQty - demand,0), forecastNextReorder)

  return (StockOnHand)

///Stock end week function call
//Hypotheses:
//Stock evo function gives the stock at the end of a week
//POs arrives at the beginning of a week
//WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank = 0 is the first week

//Initialization
where WeeklyFC.IsLastPastWeek
  Items.LastStockOnHand = same(WeeklyFC.WkStockOnHand)
  Items.LastPOArrivalQty = same(WeeklyFC.POarrivalQty)
  // Items.LastForecast = same(WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemand) //there is no forecast in last past week, so this should always be 0. Replaced by last demand
  Items.LastDemand = same(WeeklyFC.DemandQty)
  Items.LastStockEndWeek = max(Items.LastStockOnHand + Items.LastPOArrivalQty - Items.LastDemand, 0)

//Call
WeeklyFC.StockEndWeek = StockEndWeek(WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemand,
                                    Items.LastStockEndWeek,
                                    WeeklyFC.POarrivalQty + WeeklyFC.FirstReorderQty,
                                    WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemandNextReorder,
                                    WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank,
                                    WeeklyFC.IsLastPastWeek)
                        by WeeklyFC.Id
                        scan WeeklyFC.date

///Stock start week
WeeklyFC.StockStartWeek = if WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank > 0 then same(WeeklyFC.StockEndWeek)
                              when(WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank != 0)
                              by [WeeklyFC.Id, WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank]

show markdown "Project Timeline" a4g8 {tileTab: "Timeline and Milestones"} with """
  # General Timeline

  __Phase I: Data Pipeline and Cleaning__
  This phase involves the sharing of the Data Wishlist of fields and dataframes that will be required for phase 2 by Lokad, creation of an automated data pipeline
  for a daily data update, and the creation of the Data Health dashboards for checking data integrity, primary and secondary keys between tables, missing or illogical values,
  and that high level business KPIs are equivalent between Lokad and the Company.

  __Phase II: Forecasting and Optimization__
  The second phase begins with a deeper discussion of the economic and business factors that will be the primary drivers of the optimization, the scope of items to be included in the
  forecast, dispatch, and purchasing optimizations. This phase is an iterative process as the initial forecast and optimization
  is created and expected behaviors (seasonality, categories, etc.) are compared with the first results, and the scope is clarified and edge cases are handled.

  __Phase III: Prototyping, Testing, and Finetuneing__
  The final phase in the onboarding process, this is also primarily an iterative phase with the users using the recommended purchase and dispatch lists daily/weekly/etc. and
  looking for stark discrepancies compared to the expected values, and modifying or finetuneing the optimization. Additional reporting dashboards and tools are also used and modified
  as the user discovers which features they require or do not need.

  __Phase IV: Production__
  Weekly support for optimization and recommendation, as well as the creation of additional reporting dashboards if requested.

"""

//   "AutoPartsName" as Name : text
//   "Sku" as Id : text
//   StockOnHand : number
//   BackOrder : number
//   StockOnOrder : number
//   Ref : text
//   BuyPrice : number
//   SellPrice : number
//   Leadtime : number
//   ReorderCycle : number
//   "AutoPartsCategoryname" as Category : text
//   "AutoPartsBrandName" as Brand : text
//   Loc : text
//   "AutoPartsSupplier" as Supplier : text

read "/Clean/Items.ion" as Items[Id unsafe] with
  Name : text
  "Sku" as Id : text
  StockOnHand : number
  BackOrder : number
  StockOnOrder : number
  Ref : text
  BuyPrice : number
  SellPrice : number
  Leadtime : number
  ReorderCycle : number
  Category : text
  Brand : text
  Loc : text
  Supplier : text

read "\{inputFolder}Orders.ion" as Orders expect [Id, date] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  "OrderDate" as date: date
  Quantity : number
  "LokadNetAmount" as NetAmount : number
  IsClean : boolean

read "/\{inputFolder}Stock.ion" as Stock expect [Id, date] with
  "StockDate" as date: date
  "SKU" as Id : text
  StockOnHand : number
  StockOnOrder : number
  // CostPrice : number
  // const(false) as IsLegacy

read "\{inputFolder}Forecast/Periodic/WeeklyFc.ion" as WeeklyFc expect[Id, date] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  "Monday" as date: date
  TotalDemand : ranvar

read "/\{inputFolder}PO.ion" as PO expect [Id, date] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  "OrderDate" as date: date
  Loc : text
  Ref : text
  DeliveryDate : date
  Quantity : number
  Supplier : text
  PONumber : text
  IsInCatalog : boolean
  IsClean : boolean
  InputDate : date
  InputPath : text


where Items.StockOnHand == 0
  Items.StockOnHand = random.integer(Items.0,Items.5)

table ItemsWeek = cross(Items, Week)
// table ItemsMonth = cross(Items, Month)

where monday(Orders.date) == date(2021,01,04)
  Orders.Quantity = Orders.Quantity*1.25
  Orders.NetAmount = Orders.NetAmount*1.25
where Orders.date < date(2021,08,02)
  Orders.Quantity = Orders.Quantity / 1.9
  Orders.NetAmount = Orders.NetAmount / 1.9

where year(Orders.date) == 2021
  Orders.Quantity = Orders.Quantity*1.25

/// Creating dummy data for the Long Term Planning Demo Part

year = 2025

/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// # 1. Creation of the Catalog
/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

table Category = extend.range(6)
Category.Category = Category.N

Category.NbSubCategory = max(round(random.poisson(3.5 into Category),0),2)
Category.MargeLevel = random.uniform(0.05 into Category, 0.45 into Category)
Category.PeakSeasonal = round(random.uniform(3 into Category, 12 into Category),0)

table SubCategory = extend.range(Category.NbSubCategory)
SubCategory.SubCategory = SubCategory.N

SubCategory.BuyPriceLevel = random.uniform(5 into SubCategory, 300 into SubCategory)
SubCategory.NbItems = round(random.poisson(5.5 into SubCategory),0)
SubCategory.IsSeasonal = random.uniform(0 into SubCategory, 1 into SubCategory) >= 0.5

table Catalog = extend.range(SubCategory.NbItems)
Catalog.Ref = concat(Category.Category,SubCategory.SubCategory,Catalog.N)

Catalog.BuyPrice = SubCategory.BuyPriceLevel*random.uniform(0.8 into Catalog,1.2 into Catalog)
Catalog.SellPrice = Catalog.BuyPrice / (1 - Category.MargeLevel*random.uniform(0.8 into Catalog,1.2 into Catalog))
Catalog.SalesLevel = random.uniform(10 into Catalog, 750 into Catalog)
Catalog.SeasonalForce = random.uniform(2.5 into Catalog, 7 into Catalog)

show table "Category"  with
  Category.Category as "Category"
  Category.NbSubCategory as "NbSubCategory"
  Category.MargeLevel as "MargeLevel"
  Category.PeakSeasonal as "PeakSeasonal"

show table "SubCategory"  with
  SubCategory.SubCategory as "SubCategory"
  SubCategory.BuyPriceLevel as "BuyPriceLevel"
  SubCategory.NbItems as "NbItems"
  SubCategory.IsSeasonal as "IsSeasonal"

show piechart "Category" with
  count(Catalog.*)
  group by Category.Category into Catalog

show table "SubCategory" with
  Category.Category into Catalog
  SubCategory.SubCategory into Catalog
  count(Catalog.*) as "# Ref"
  group by [Category.Category into Catalog, SubCategory.SubCategory into Catalog]
  order by same(Category.Category into Catalog) desc

Catalog.Supplier = concat("Supplier ", floor(random.uniform(1 into Catalog, 8 into Catalog)))


/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// # 2. Creation of the Forecast
/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

table Forecast = extend.range(Catalog.12)
Forecast.MonthF = month(year,Forecast.N)

Forecast.DistanceToPeak = min(abs(monthNum(Forecast.MonthF) - Category.PeakSeasonal), 12 - abs(monthNum(Forecast.MonthF) - Category.PeakSeasonal))
Forecast.PeakCoeff = if Forecast.DistanceToPeak <= 1 then 1 else if Forecast.DistanceToPeak == 2 then 0.33 else 0
Forecast.Baseline = if not SubCategory.IsSeasonal then random.uniform(0.75 into Forecast, 1.25 into Forecast) * Catalog.SalesLevel
                    else (1+ Catalog.SeasonalForce*Forecast.PeakCoeff)/3 *random.uniform(0.8 into Forecast, 1.2 into Forecast) *Catalog.SalesLevel

/// Add Seasonality on BF/Christmas for everyone
Forecast.Baseline = if monthNum(Forecast.MonthF) == 10 then Forecast.Baseline * 1.2 else
                    if monthNum(Forecast.MonthF) == 11 then Forecast.Baseline * 1.6 else
                    if monthNum(Forecast.MonthF) == 12 then Forecast.Baseline * 1.4
                    else Forecast.Baseline

show table "Forecast"  with
  Catalog.Ref
  Forecast.MonthF as "Month"

  sum(Forecast.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice) when (Category.Category == 2) as "Cat. 2" {unit: "€"; seriesType: bar ;seriesStack: bar}

/// Input:  /Clean/

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
/// --------------------------------------READ INPUT TABLES-----------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
import "/1. utilities/Modules/Global Parameters" as GP with
  DcUnit
  LinkHomeDashboard

const testStorage = ""
const inputPath = "\{testStorage}/Clean/"

read "\{inputPath}Items.ion" as Items[Id unsafe] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  Category : text
  SellPrice : number
  BuyPrice : number
  StockOnHand : number
  LeadTime : number
  ReorderCycle : number
  IsClean : boolean

read "/Manual/TopItemsParameters.xlsx" unsafe as TopItemsParameters expect[Id] with
  CategoryDisplayRank : number
  Category : text
  "Sku" as Id : text

read "\{testStorage}Clean/Orders.ion" as Orders expect [Id, date] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  "OrderDate" as date: date
  LokadNetAmount : number

read "/Clean/PO.ion" as PO expect[Id, date] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  "OrderDate" as date: date
  DeliveryDate : date
  Quantity : number

read "/Clean/Stock.ion" as Stock expect[Id, date] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  StockOnHand : number
  "StockDate" as date: date

read "\{inputPath}Forecast/Periodic/WeeklyFc.ion" as WeeklyFC expect[Id, date] with
  "Sku" as Id : text
  "Monday" as date: date
  DemandQty : number
  IsPast : boolean
  IsSLT : boolean
  IsWOO : boolean
  FutureWeekRank : number
  Alpha : number
  Dispersion : number
  Baseline : number
  CumDemand : ranvar

read "/Clean/Parameters/max_date_placeholder.csv" unsafe as DatePlaceholder expect[date] with
  date: date

read upload "slicedform" as Submitted min 0 with
  Category : text
  "Agressiveness Factor (0 - 5)" as AgressivenessFactor : number

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
/// ------------------------------------------SETUP-------------------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

show tabs "" a2h2 with
  "OverallView" as "Overall View"
  "CategoryView" as "Category View"


///Editable body------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

show logo "" a1
show markdown "Inventory Optimization - Projected development" b1f1 with """
  ### **Inventory Optimization - Projected development**
"""

// show label "" f29 9b9b9b

show label "" a17h17 9b9b9b {labelBorder: "top"}
// show label "" f18 000000 {labelBorder: "top"}
// show label "" h17 000000 {labelBorder: "top"}


show label "To Home" g1h1                {href: #("https://go.lokad.com/d/\{LinkHomeDashboard}/") ; hrefAspect: white ; textAlign: center}


// show markdown "Current Suggestions" c17 with """
//   ### **Stock - Current Suggestions**
// """

///Stock end week-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//We simulate the ideal stock, i.e. the stock which perfectly compensates the demand.
//To do so, we calculate the demand on a reorder cycle (except for the first reorder cycle) and
//we offset it to make it arrive one SLT after

WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemand = quantile(WeeklyFC.CumDemand, 0.9) - quantile(WeeklyFC.PreviousCumDemand, 0.9)//quantile(WeeklyFC.CumDemand, Items.NewFR) - quantile(WeeklyFC.PreviousCumDemand, Items.NewFR) [!!!!!!!!!!!]
//WeeklyFC.Baseline//quantile(WeeklyFC.Demand, Items.NewFR)

///Demand on next reorder cycle
ItemsWeek.ReplicateDemand = same(WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemand)
                              by [WeeklyFC.Id, WeeklyFC.date]
                              at [Items.Id, Week.monday]
ItemsWeek.ReplicateDemandNextReorder = sum(ItemsWeek.ReplicateDemand) by ItemsWeek.Id over week = [0 .. Items.ReorderCycleWeeks - 1]
WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemandNextReorder = if max(WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank - Items.TotalLTWeeks,0) mod Items.ReorderCycleWeeks == 0 and WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank - Items.TotalLTWeeks >= 0
                                      then same(ItemsWeek.ReplicateDemandNextReorder) by [Items.Id, Week.monday] at [WeeklyFC.Id, WeeklyFC.date]
                                      else 0

///Stock end week function
def process StockEndWeek(
    demand:number, /// demand quantity in selected time interval
    startStockOnHand: number,
    arrivalQty: number,
    forecastNextReorder : number,
    timeIndex : number,
    isLastPastWeek : boolean) with /// Define if the stocklevel can fall below 0 (= BackOrders)
  keep StockOnHand = 0

  if timeIndex == 0
    StockOnHand = 0
  if isLastPastWeek
    StockOnHand = startStockOnHand
  if timeIndex >= 1
    StockOnHand = max(max(StockOnHand + arrivalQty - demand,0), forecastNextReorder)

  return (StockOnHand)

///Stock end week function call
//Hypotheses:
//Stock evo function gives the stock at the end of a week
//POs arrives at the beginning of a week
//WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank = 0 is the first week

//Initialization
where WeeklyFC.IsLastPastWeek
  Items.LastStockOnHand = same(WeeklyFC.WkStockOnHand)
  Items.LastPOArrivalQty = same(WeeklyFC.POarrivalQty)
  Items.LastForecast = same(WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemand)
  Items.LastStockEndWeek = max(Items.LastStockOnHand + Items.LastPOArrivalQty - Items.LastForecast, 0)

//Call
WeeklyFC.StockEndWeek = StockEndWeek(WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemand,
                                    Items.LastStockEndWeek,
                                    WeeklyFC.POarrivalQty + WeeklyFC.FirstReorderQty,
                                    WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemandNextReorder,
                                    WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank,
                                    WeeklyFC.IsLastPastWeek)
                        by WeeklyFC.Id
                        scan WeeklyFC.date

///Stock start week
WeeklyFC.StockStartWeek = if WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank > 0 then same(WeeklyFC.StockEndWeek)
                              when(WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank != 0)
                              by [WeeklyFC.Id, WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank]
                              at [WeeklyFC.Id, WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank - 1] default Items.LastStockEndWeek else 0

///Future reorders arrival quantities---------------------------------------------------------------
WeeklyFC.FutureReordersQty = if (WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank - Items.SupplierLTWeeks) >= 0 and//Before SLT
                              (WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank - Items.SupplierLTWeeks) mod Items.ReorderCycleWeeks == 0 then//Every multiple of a reorder cycle
                                max(WeeklyFC.StockEndWeek
                                - WeeklyFC.StockStartWeek
                                - WeeklyFC.POarrivalQty
                                + WeeklyFC.ReplicateDemand, 0) else 0

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

`Name`: reference name.

`Category`: reference category.

__`Dispatch suggestion`__: recommended dispatch quantity to cover the next responsibility window.

__`Current Fill Rate`__: overall fill rate associated to the current stock on hand and on order, i.e. the proportion of the demand
already covered by the current stock on hand and on order.

__`Achieved Fill Rate`__: overall fill rate associated to the current stock on hand and on order and the recommended dispatch suggestion, i.e. the proportion of the demand
which will be covered after dispatching.

`Stock DC before Dispatch`: quantity in stock in the central warehouse (DC) before any dispatch decision.

`Stock DC after Dispatch`: quantity in stock in the central warehouse (DC) after applying all dispatch suggestions.

### Documentation Micro Decisions

#### General Remark:

To perform this dispatch optimization, we compute for each dispatchable unit, whether it is more profitable
to send it to 1 of the 2 downstream location of to keep it in DC. In order to do that, we virtually empty the stock in DC and then, for each unit
compute the reward of putting it back in DC or sending it to EDB, MAN and LON.

The micro decisions represent the status of each of these decisions so, in this table, the currentFR in DC is the FR without StockOnHand (ie 0 if there is no StockOnOrder).

`Rank`: Order of the micro decisions (sorted by descending Score).

`StockOnHand`: Stock on hand before dispatch in the location.

`LotMultiplier`: numbers of pcs by which we can dispatch the Sku (for one ref, can change depending on the location).

`Min`: rank of the 1st unit dispatched with this decision.

`Max`: rank of the last unit dispatched with this decision.

`Q`: quantity we are considering dispatching for this decision (1 if no specific constraint, more if LotMultiplier or MOQ). Equal to Max-Min+1.

`Reward`: Expected economic gain of the decision.

`Score`: ROI of the decision (if positive). The decisions with the highest score are the most interesting economically.

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
/// ------------------------------------------SETUP-------------------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

///Colors-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

highlightColor =  ColorB
ColorWarning =  ColorWarning
LinkLocationItemInspector =  LinkLocationItemInspector

backgroundColorforsummarytile = "#f5f5f5"

///Global parameters--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pcsUnit = " Pcs"
oend = max(WeeklyFC.date) when(WeeklyFC.IsPast)

///Global parameters--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
show tabs "" a1f1 with
  "Main"
  "Parameters, Alerts and Documentation"
  "Mid Term Simulation"
  "Export" {tabDisplay: "false"}

///Editable body------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


show label "Dispatch suggestions" a2f2 {textAlign: center ; textVerticalAlign: center ; textBold: "true"}


// show label "https://go.lokad.com/d/66208/ Configuration de l'optimisation de dispatch" f1h1                                                  {labelIcon: "container" ; textAlign: center ; hrefAspect: white ; tileColor: #(highlightColor)}

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
///---------------------------------------PREPROCESS----------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Skus.M = Skus.SellPrice - Skus.BuyPrice
Skus.MarginRate = Skus.M/Skus.SellPrice
Skus.RankMarginRate = rankrev()  scan Skus.MarginRate
Skus.RankMarginRatePercent = Skus.RankMarginRate/(count(Skus.*) by Skus.1)
Skus.StockOnHand = if Skus.Loc == "DC" then round(Skus.StockOnHand*1.4) else Skus.StockOnHand


selectedTab = concat("&t=", "Info")
Skus.Url_ItemInspector = sliceSearchUrl(LinkLocationItemInspector,Skus.Sku)

Skus.CategoryDisplayRank = same(TopItemsParameters.CategoryDisplayRank)
                            by TopItemsParameters.Category
                            at Skus.Category

Skus.ItemDisplayRank = same(TopItemsParameters.ItemDisplayRank)
Skus.IsTopItem = any(TopItemsParameters.*)

///Global parameters--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
keep where Skus.IsClean
keep where PO.DeliveryDate > oend + 7

table SkusWeek = cross(Skus, Week)


Week.monday = monday(week)

lastPastWeek = max(WeeklyFC.date) when(WeeklyFC.FutureWeekRank == 0)
WeeklyFC.IsLastPastWeek = WeeklyFC.date == lastPastWeek

lookbackDays = 52 * 7
lookforwardDays = 26 * 7

    LeadTime: poisson(Skus.DispatchLTWeeks),

  Skus.MeanPriorDemand = sum(WeeklyFC.Baseline)
                        when (WeeklyFC.TimeIndex >= Skus.DispatchLTWeeks and
                        WeeklyFC.TimeIndex < Skus.DispatchLTWeeks + Skus.RedispatchCycleWeeks)

      Grid.IsEligible = Grid.IsEnoughStockRemaining and
                        (Grid.CumFRGainEDB <= (locFRTarget - EDBCurrentFR) or Grid.Loc != "EDB") and
                        (Grid.CumFRGainLON <= (locFRTarget - LONCurrentFR) or Grid.Loc != "LON") and
                        (Grid.CumFRGainMAN <= (locFRTarget - MANCurrentFR) or Grid.Loc != "MAN") and

    where Grid.IsEligible
