      Skus.DispatchQuantityWarehouse = sum(Grid.Q) when(Grid.Loc != "DC") by [Grid.Ref] at [Skus.Ref] //qty that leaves from entrepot


 //Writing full prioritized list
    // where Grid.IsEnoughStockRemaining //discussion with Fabian : only wants to display all possible decisions
    show table "Grid"  write: "Clean/DispatchResults/MicroDecisions.ion"  {tileTab: "Export"} with
      Grid.Rank as "Rank"
      Skus.LastYearSales
      Skus.SalesWeight * 100
      Grid.Loc as "Loc"
      Grid.Ref as "Ref"
      Sku as "Sku"
      Skus.Category
      Skus.BuyPrice

      Grid.FillRateDelta {numbers: percent}
      Grid.CumFillRateDelta {numbers: percent}
      Grid.OverallFRGain {numbers: percent}
      Grid.CumOverallFRGain {numbers: percent}
      Grid.CumStockDispatchedByRef

      Grid.CumFRGainLON + LONCurrentFR as "NewFR LON" {numbers: percent}
      Grid.CumFRGainMAN + MANCurrentFR as "NewFR MAN" {numbers: percent}
      Grid.IsBelowTargetEDB
      Grid.IsBelowTargetLON
      Grid.IsBelowTargetMAN
      (Grid.CumFRGainDC <= (1 - DCCurrentFR) or Grid.Loc != "DC")
      locFRTarget as "FR target by location" {numbers: percent}


      Grid.Reward as "Reward" {numbers: simple ; minPrecision: 8}
      Grid.Score  as "Score" {numbers: simple ; minPrecision: 8}

      Grid.IsEnoughStockRemaining
      Grid.IsEligible

      order by Grid.Rank

 //Displaying full simplified prioritized list
    // where Grid.IsEnoughStockRemaining //discussion with Fabian : only wants to display all possible decisions
    description = "All possible decisions (unit by unit) weighted in the optimisation."

      Grid.Rank = rank(Grid.Score, Sku, -Grid.Max)///We rank again just to display something where a prospect is not surprised

### Documentation Dispatch Suggestions

  This explanation uses examples of the scenario with an input target FR of 90%. For other input values the results will be a bit different but the general ideas remain valid.

  #### Fill rate

  The target fill rate is used to limit the amount of stock you'd like to ship to the downstream warehouses. It is important to be able to control
  this as we assume here that, once the stock is shipped to one of the downstream locations, it is stuck there.

  ##### Things to notice regarding the overall FR:
  * The overall fill rate increases: thanks to this dispatch optimization, we make the most of the stock we have. We lose a little bit of FR in DC
  to win more in the other locations -> we move the stock to the locations where it has the most impact.

  ##### Things to notice regarding the overall FR:
  * The overall fill rate increases: thanks to this dispatch optimization, we make the most of the stock we have. We lose a little bit of FR in DC
  to win more in the other locations -> we move the stock to the locations where it has the most impact.
  * We reach 90% FR for EDB and LON: we reached the limit set by the target FR. There could be extra dispatch decisions that could make sense but,

  * We are above 90% for MAN: we are already well above the target at MAN so it is not worth it to dispatch anything there.
  * We do not have any products for which the dispatch empties the stock in DC. This is a possibility that might happen if there is very few demand in DC compared to the downstream locations and/or
  there is an imminent stock arrival in DC.

  #### Underlying hypotheses:

  The window of opportunity considered for the warehouses are:
  * The redispatch period (3 or 4 weeks) for the dowstream locations. It is the shortest time between 2 possible stock arrivals (assuming the SLT for the purchase is bigger than this which is the case here)
  * The SLT for DC. It is a much larger location but, as there is no dispatch possible for DC, we need to have enough stock to cover at least from here to the next stock arrival, that can't happen before 1 SLT.

  Having a larger horizon considered for DC is one way of pushing the optimization to prefer keeping stock in the upstream warehouse.

show linechart "Simulated Dispatch Quantities over a month" a5g8 {tileTab: #(currentTab)}  with

  round(sum(SimulationStandard.StockDelivered)) as "Receptions" {seriesFan: 2 ; seriesType: bar ; seriesLegendRank: "3" ; color: #(GP.colorSkyBlue)}
  same(SimulationStandard.constraints) as "Capacity constraint"{color: "red"}
  0 as "" {seriesFan: 4 ; seriesType: bar ; seriesLegendRank: "4" ; color: "white" ; seriesDisplay: "false"}
  group by SimulationStandard.DispatchDate

SimulationStandard.Margin = SimulationStandard.OrderedQty * (Skus.M)
SimulationStandard.CumQtyByDayByMargin = cumsum(SimulationStandard.OrderedQty) by (SimulationStandard.DispatchDate) scan -SimulationStandard.Margin

where SimulationStandard.OrderedQty > 0
  show table "Daily dispatch anticipated" a9g9 {tileTab: #(currentTab)}  with
    Skus.Ref
    SimulationStandard.Sku
    SimulationStandard.DispatchDate
    SimulationStandard.OrderedQty as "Quantity"
    SimulationStandard.Margin

SimulationStandard.TotalOrderedQtyPerDay = sum(SimulationStandard.OrderedQty) by SimulationStandard.DispatchDate

Day.QteSimuStandard = sum(SimulationStandard.OrderedQty) by SimulationStandard.DispatchDate at Day.date
Day.OverDispatch = max(0,Day.QteSimuStandard-constraints)
Day.LeftCapacity = max(0,constraints-Day.QteSimuStandard)
Day.MarginAtRisk = sum(abs(SimulationStandard.Margin)) when (SimulationStandard.CumQtyByDayByMargin > constraints)  by SimulationStandard.DispatchDate at Day.date
totaloverdispatch = sum(Day.OverDispatch) when (month(Day.date) == GP.monthdispatchflux)
totaloverleftcapacity= sum(Day.LeftCapacity) when (month(Day.date) == GP.monthdispatchflux)
totalmarginatRisk= sum(Day.MarginAtRisk) when (month(Day.date) == GP.monthdispatchflux)

emojicapacity = if totaloverleftcapacity > totaloverdispatch then "https://go.lokad.com/DEMO/gateway/BigFiles/Browse/Download?hash=4D3CDB0DCF11F315C19E04CB64DEABB0&path=%2FImages&name=GreenBox.png"
    else "https://go.lokad.com/DEMO/gateway/BigFiles/Browse/Download?hash=9570B3A9793601A152A88FBFF93FEACA&path=%2FImages&name=RedBox-24.png"

textlabellissagecolor = if totaloverleftcapacity > totaloverdispatch then "#06990b" else "red"

  Same columns as in Items by Stock Value

  __Stock outs evolution__: weekly proportion of references out of stock and average estimated missed turnover due to stock outs

  __Skus Overstocked__: number of references overstocked. A reference is considered overstocked if its total stock value (stock on hand + on order)
  exceeds its maximum demand scenario on the next supplier leadtime + reorder cycle period

  __Overstock__: overstock amount across all references

  __Overstocked Items__: list of all references overstocked

  __Top x items overstocked__: list of top x items overstocked by decreasing amount of overstock

PO.Unsold = fifo(max(Items.StockOnHand,0), PO.DeliveryDate, PO.ArrivedQty)
PO.Age = (today() - PO.DeliveryDate) // age in days
Items.Age = sum(PO.Unsold * PO.Age) /. sum(PO.Unsold)

Items.StockAge =  Items.Age  //same(Ap.Age)

oend = max(Orders.date)

                          else single(GeneralParametrisation.GrowthCat) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category.Category

Orders.IsPickRandomBucket = argfirst() by [Catalog.Sku, Orders.BucketNew] scan Orders.RndDemand
where Orders.IsPickRandomBucket
  Orders.RawRndBaseDemand = max(Orders.RndBucketDemand - Orders.SumRndBaseDemandByBucket, 0)

///Safeguards
Catalog.SalesRanvar = ranvar(Orders.RawRndBaseDemand) by Catalog.Sku at Catalog.Sku
Catalog.SalesRanvarMean = mean(Catalog.SalesRanvar)
Catalog.SalesRanvarStd = sqrt(variance(Catalog.SalesRanvar))

Catalog.SalesRanvarQ99 = quantile(Catalog.SalesRanvar, 0.99)

Orders.RawRndBaseDemand = min(Orders.RawRndBaseDemand, min(Catalog.SalesRanvarMean + 4 * Catalog.SalesRanvarStd, Catalog.SalesRanvarQ99))

///Extreme bimodal demand
Catalog.ExtremeBimodalDemandFrequence = if Catalog.IsBimodalDemand then 0.2 else 0
Catalog.ExtremeBimodalDemandFactor = 2

Orders.IsExtremeBimodalDemand = Catalog.IsBimodalDemand and
                                Orders.DayIndex mod ((1 /. Catalog.ExtremeBimodalDemandFrequence) * Catalog.ReorderCycle / 2) == 0
                                //Division per 2 to fake twice the frequence in the orders generation while we want to display only the frequence in the distribution itself

Orders.ExtremeBimodalDemandFactor = if Orders.IsExtremeBimodalDemand then Catalog.ExtremeBimodalDemandFactor else 1

///Extreme right skewed demand
Catalog.ExtremeRightSkewedDemandFrequence = if Catalog.IsRightSkewedDemand then 0.1 else 0
Catalog.ExtremeRightSkewedDemandFactor = 5

Orders.IsExtremeRightSkewedDemand = Catalog.IsRightSkewedDemand and
                                    Orders.DayIndex mod ((1 /. Catalog.ExtremeRightSkewedDemandFrequence) * 7) == 0

Orders.ExtremeRightSkewedDemandFactor = if Orders.IsExtremeRightSkewedDemand then
                                              Catalog.ExtremeRightSkewedDemandFactor * (0.2 + 0.8 * random.uniform(Orders.0,Orders.1))
    else
                                              1

///Final Rnd Base demand
Orders.RndBaseDemand = if Orders.IsExtremeBimodalDemand or Orders.IsExtremeRightSkewedDemand then Orders.RndAvgBucketDemand * Orders.ExtremeBimodalDemandFactor * Orders.ExtremeRightSkewedDemandFactor else Orders.RawRndBaseDemand

show table "Test" a30 with
  Catalog.Sku
  Catalog.IsRightSkewedDemand
  1 /. Catalog.ExtremeRightSkewedDemandFrequence
  Orders.DayIndex
  Orders.Day
  Orders.IsExtremeRightSkewedDemand
  Orders.RndAvgBucketDemand
  Orders.ExtremeBimodalDemandFactor
  Orders.ExtremeRightSkewedDemandFactor
  Orders.RndBaseDemand

Orders.WeekBaseDemand = (UserDefinedTimeOrders.BucketBase / Catalog.PeriodGroupSize) * 7

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
///--------------------------------------REPORTING------------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

///Overall overview

Orders.IsFirstOrderOfWeek = argwhichever() by [Orders.Sku , monday(Orders.Day)]
keep where Orders.RndBaseDemand > 0 or Orders.IsFirstOrderOfWeek

iteration = 1
itText = padLeft(text(iteration),"0",2)
checkDashboard = 51914
Catalog.hRefUrl = sliceSearchUrl(checkDashboard, Catalog.Sku)
Catalog.SumByItems = sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand * Catalog.SellPrice) when (Orders.IsPast)

show summary "Items Output" a23c23               {backgroundColor: #F8F8F8} with
  distinct(Catalog.ItemName) as "# Item"
  distinct(Catalog.SubCategory) as "# Category"
  distinct(Catalog.Brand) as "# Brand"
  max(Catalog.BuyPrice) as "Max BuyPrice"
  max(Catalog.SellPrice) as "Max SellPrice"
  max(Catalog.LotMultiplier) as "Max LotMultiplier"
  max(Catalog.Moq) as "Max Moq"

show summary "Items Output" a22c22                {backgroundColor: #F8F8F8} with
  distinct(Catalog.ItemName) as "# Item" //
  sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand * Catalog.SellPrice) as "Total NetAmount"
  sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand * (Catalog.SellPrice - Catalog.BuyPrice)) as "Total Gross Margin"
  min(Orders.Day) as "MinDay"
  max(Orders.Day) as "MaxDay"
  distinct(Catalog.Currency) as "# Currency"

Catalog.ItemRank = rankrev () scan Catalog.1

item1 = same(Catalog.ItemCode) when (Catalog.ItemRank == 1)

show table "Sliced Buckets" a20d20 0F0774 slices:slice  with
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.BucketIndex
  Catalog.Sku
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.RndQuantile
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.BaseDemand
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.BaseDemandPlusGrowth

  UserDefinedTimeOrders.DemandSegment

show table "Sliced Orders" e20h20 0F0774 slices:slice  with
  Catalog.Sku as "Sku"
  Orders.Ref
  Orders.Loc
  Orders.Day as "OrderDate"
  Orders.RndBaseDemand as "Quantity"
  Orders.RndBaseDemand * Catalog.SellPrice as "NetAmount"
  Catalog.SellPrice
  Orders.WeekBaseDemand
  Catalog.Currency as "Currency"
  Orders.OrderId
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.RndQuantile
  Orders.OrderRndWeight
  Orders.OrderWeightInBucket
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.BaseDemand
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.BaseDemandPlusGrowth
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.RndBucket
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.DemandSegment
  // Orders.SumRndBaseDemandByBucket
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.BucketIndex
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.BucketBase
  Catalog.Dispersion
  Catalog.Alpha
  order by Orders.Day

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
///---------------------------------------EXPORT--------------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

show label "Export" a21h21

where Orders.IsPast
  show table "Orders Output" d26h27 write: "\{projectFolder}Input/Orders/Orders_\{itText}.ion" with
    Catalog.Sku as "Sku"
    Orders.Ref
    Orders.Loc
    Orders.Day as "OrderDate"
    Orders.RawRndBaseDemand as "RawQuantity"
    Orders.RndBaseDemand as "Quantity"
    Orders.RndBaseDemand * Catalog.SellPrice as "NetAmount"
    Orders.WeekBaseDemand
    Catalog.Currency as "Currency"
    Orders.OrderId

  ///Spot mistakes
  show linechart "Orders evolution" with
    sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand)
    group by monday(Orders.Day)

  debut = date(2022,10,31)
  issue = date(2023,01,16)
  fin = date(2023,02,06)
  Orders.IsIssuePeriod = Orders.Day >= issue and Orders.Day < fin
  Catalog.WeeklyAverageBeforeDecrease = sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand) when(Orders.Day >= debut and Orders.Day < issue) / (issue - debut) * 7
  Catalog.WeeklyAverageAfterDecrease = sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand) when(Orders.Day >= issue and Orders.Day < fin) / (fin - issue) * 7
  UserDefinedTimeOrders.Day = max(Orders.Day) //just for debug
  Catalog.RndQuantileBeforeDecrease = avg(UserDefinedTimeOrders.RndQuantile) when(UserDefinedTimeOrders.Day >= debut and UserDefinedTimeOrders.Day < issue) / (issue - debut) * 7
  Catalog.RndQuantileAfterDecrease = avg(UserDefinedTimeOrders.RndQuantile) when(UserDefinedTimeOrders.Day >= issue and UserDefinedTimeOrders.Day < fin) / (fin - issue) * 7
  where Catalog.WeeklyAverageBeforeDecrease * 0.7 > Catalog.WeeklyAverageAfterDecrease
    Catalog.Rank = rankrev () scan -Catalog.WeeklyAverageBeforeDecrease
    show table "Check Cat" with
      Catalog.Rank
      Catalog.Sku
      Catalog.BucketsNb
      Catalog.BucketSize
      Catalog.PeriodGroupSize
      Catalog.WeeklyAverageBeforeDecrease
      Catalog.WeeklyAverageAfterDecrease
      Catalog.WeeklyAverageBeforeDecrease/.Catalog.WeeklyAverageAfterDecrease as "Ratio"
      Catalog.RndQuantileBeforeDecrease
      Catalog.RndQuantileAfterDecrease
      Catalog.StartDate
      Catalog.EndDate
      order by Catalog.WeeklyAverageBeforeDecrease/.Catalog.WeeklyAverageAfterDecrease desc

    show linechart "Orders evolution decreasing refs" with
      sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand) as "All"
      sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand) when(Catalog.Rank==1) as "1" {color : orange}
      sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand) when(Catalog.Rank==2) as "2"
      sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand) when(Catalog.Rank==3) as "3"
      sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand) when(Catalog.Rank==4) as "4"
      group by monday(Orders.Day)

    show linechart "Orders evolution decreasing refs - slice" slices:slice with
      sum(Orders.RndBaseDemand)
      group by monday(Orders.Day)

    show table "Check Orders" with

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
///----------------------------------------Dispatch LIST--------------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
//All stock in DC potentially can be dispatched to any of the locations
Skus.StockAvailableForDispatch = single(Skus.StockOnHand) when(Skus.Loc == "DC") by Skus.Ref
//As there is also demand in DC, we wirtually empty DC from all its stock
//and we will reaffect it in the relevant locations (DC being one of the options)
Skus.StockAvailable = if Skus.Loc == "DC" then 0 else Skus.StockOnHand

Skus.Dispersion = same(WeeklyFC.Dispersion)
Skus.Alpha = same(WeeklyFC.Alpha)

trajectoryCount = 500

WeeklyFC.TimeIndex = 0
WeeklyFC.CumDemand = dirac(0)

//in real life you shouldn't use poisson() but a distribution that fits what you can expect from the supplier
//typically computed from the PO history
// Skus.SumBaselineLT = sum(WeeklyFC.Baseline) when(WeeklyFC.Date >= now and WeeklyFC.Date < now + Skus.RedispatchCycleWeeks)

where (not WeeklyFC.IsPast) or WeeklyFC.Date == oend //currentWeek defined as past in preprocessing
                                                     //for dispatch we take it into account as we can have a 0 weeks LT
  WeeklyFC.TimeIndex = (rankrev () by WeeklyFC.Sku scan -WeeklyFC.Date) - 1 //start rank at 0, needed for 0 weeks LT

  ///Satisfiable demand and Holding time
  Skus.SatisfiableDemand, Skus.HoldingTime = actionrwd.reward(
    TimeIndex: WeeklyFC.TimeIndex,
    Baseline: WeeklyFC.Baseline,
    Dispersion: Skus.Dispersion,
    Alpha: Skus.Alpha,
    StockOnHand: Skus.StockAvailable,
    StockOnOrder : PO.Quantity,
    ArrivalTime : poisson(ceiling(PO.ArrivalTime)), //dirac(0) --> considered as stock on hand, error if < 0
    LeadTime: poisson(Skus.DispatchLTWeeks),
    StepOfReorder: Skus.RedispatchCycleWeeks,
    Samples: trajectoryCount,
    Seed: 1)

  //Rwd
  Skus.StockLeftEndDispatchLT = max(0, -Skus.SatisfiableDemand)

  //Fillrate
  // Skus.MeanPriorDemand = mean(Skus.DemandOLT)
  Skus.MeanPriorDemand = sum(WeeklyFC.Baseline)
                        when (WeeklyFC.TimeIndex >= Skus.DispatchLTWeeks and
                        WeeklyFC.TimeIndex < Skus.DispatchLTWeeks + Skus.RedispatchCycleWeeks)

  Skus.SatisfiedDemand = round(max(0, Skus.MeanPriorDemand - mean(Skus.SatisfiableDemand))) //Demand satisfied by the available stock by the end of t + SLT. Just for
  Skus.TotalDemand = Skus.SatisfiableDemand + Skus.SatisfiedDemand // All these offset
  // Skus.FillRateTotalDemand = fillrate(Skus.TotalDemand)

  WeeklyFC.CumDemand = actionrwd.demand(
    TimeIndex: WeeklyFC.TimeIndex,
    BaseLine: WeeklyFC.Baseline,
    Dispersion: Skus.Dispersion,
    Alpha: Skus.Alpha)

  WeeklyFC.PreviousCumDemand = same(WeeklyFC.CumDemand)
                                when(WeeklyFC.TimeIndex != 0)
                                by [WeeklyFC.Sku, WeeklyFC.TimeIndex]
                                at [WeeklyFC.Sku, WeeklyFC.TimeIndex - 1]

  ///Satisfied demand

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

//and we will reaffect it in the relevant locations (DC being one of the options)

Skus.Alpha = same(WeeklyFC.Alpha)

trajectoryCount = 500

WeeklyFC.TimeIndex = 0
WeeklyFC.CumDemand = dirac(0)

`Category`: reference category.

__`Dispatch suggestion`__: recommended dispatch quantity to cover the next responsibility window.

__`Current Fill Rate`__: overall fill rate associated to the current stock on hand and on order, i.e. the proportion of the demand
already covered by the current stock on hand and on order.

__`Achieved Fill Rate`__: overall fill rate associated to the current stock on hand and on order and the recommended dispatch suggestion, i.e. the proportion of the demand
which will be covered after dispatching.

`Stock DC before Dispatch`: quantity in stock in the central warehouse (DC) before any dispatch decision.

`Stock DC after Dispatch`: quantity in stock in the central warehouse (DC) after applying all dispatch suggestions.

### Documentation Micro Decisions

#### General Remark:

To perform this dispatch optimization, we compute for each dispatchable unit, whether it is more profitable
to send it to 1 of the 2 downstream location of to keep it in DC. In order to do that, we virtually empty the stock in DC and then, for each unit
compute the reward of putting it back in DC or sending it to EDB, MAN and LON.

The micro decisions represent the status of each of these decisions so, in this table, the currentFR in DC is the FR without StockOnHand (ie 0 if there is no StockOnOrder).

`Rank`: Order of the micro decisions (sorted by descending Score).

`StockOnHand`: Stock on hand before dispatch in the location.

`LotMultiplier`: numbers of pcs by which we can dispatch the Sku (for one ref, can change depending on the location).

`Min`: rank of the 1st unit dispatched with this decision.

`Max`: rank of the last unit dispatched with this decision.

`Q`: quantity we are considering dispatching for this decision (1 if no specific constraint, more if LotMultiplier or MOQ). Equal to Max-Min+1.

`Q`: quantity we are considering dispatching for this decision (1 if no specific constraint, more if LotMultiplier or MOQ). Equal to Max-Min+1.

`Transportation LT`: time it takes for a unit to be available in the destination location from the moment the dispatch decision is taken. It includes loading and unloading the truck and the time of the drive.

`CurrentFR`: Sku's FR before dispatch.

`FillRateDelta`: Sku's FR gain if the decision is selected.

`CumFillRateDelta`: Sku's FR gain if the decision and the previous ones are selected.

`OverallFRGain`: Overall FR gain if the decision is selected.

`CumOverallFRGain`: Overall FR gain if the decision and all the possible previous possible decisions are selected.

`CumStockDispatchedByRef`: Quantity dispatched by Sku if the decision and the previous ones are selected.

`NewFR EDB/MAN/LON`: FR in EDB/MAN/LON if the decision and all the possible previous possible decisions are selected.

`FR target by location`: Maximum FR reachable for each location (manual input, forced to 100% for DC).

`Reward`: Expected economic gain of the decision.

`Score`: ROI of the decision (if positive). The decisions with the highest score are the most interesting economically.

`IsEnoughStockRemaining`: is there enough stock available to take this dispatch decision knowing the initial stock and the quantity dispatched with the previous eligible decisions.

`IsEligible`: Decision selected for dispatch (enough stock and below FR target).

"""


////Tab "Simulation Moyen Terme"

  round(sum(SimulationStandard.StockDelivered)) as "Réceptions" {seriesFan: 2 ; seriesType: bar ; seriesLegendRank: "3" ; color: #(GP.colorSkyBlue)}
  same(SimulationStandard.constraints) as "Contrainte de capacité"{color: "red"}
  0 as "" {seriesFan: 4 ; seriesType: bar ; seriesLegendRank: "4" ; color: "white" ; seriesDisplay: "false"}

SimulationStandard.CumQtyByDayByMargin = cumsum(SimulationStandard.OrderedQty) by (SimulationStandard.DispatchDate) scan -SimulationStandard.Margin

---
#### **Definition**

- The fill rate is the fraction of customer demand that is met through immediate stock availability,
without backorders or lost sales.
- The fill rate differs from the SL indicator. The fill rate
has a considerable appeal to practitioners because it represents the fraction of the demand that is likely
to be recovered or better serviced if the inventory performance was to be improved.
- The fill rate is measured
empirically by averaging the number of correctly serviced requests over the total number of requests.
- Entire fillrate definition and documentation can be found [[here]](https://www.lokad.com/fill-rate-definition).
"""

---

#### **Fill rate and service level are distinct**

- The service level is often mistakenly confused with the fill rate, and vice-versa. Yet, the two indicators
are numerically different.
- While the two indicators are quite correlated, it is possible to find
real-world situations were a high service level does not translate into a high fill rate, and the
other way around.
- Such situations tend to arise more frequently when demand is sparse
(as for spare parts for example) or when demand is erratic (as in the case of books).

"""

- There is 1 order per day on average.

- In addition to this, 1 request out of 20, comes from a school teacher

  lastYearSalesDC = sum(Orders.LokadNetAmount) when(Orders.Loc == "DC")

keep where Catalog.Category == Category
CatColor = match Category with
  1 -> C.color1b
  2 -> C.color2b
  3 -> C.color3b
  4 -> C.color4b
  5 -> C.color5b
  6 -> C.color6b
  .. -> "black"

/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
///# 1. Creation of the Slicing
/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

table SubCategory = by Catalog.SubCategory
SubCategory.SubCategory = same(Catalog.SubCategory)
SubCategory.Color = C.SubCatColor(Category, SubCategory.SubCategory)

nbSubCat = count(SubCategory.*)
nbOption = 20

SubCategory.Choice = nbOption^2

table SliceParameters = extend.range(SubCategory.Choice)

SliceParameters.CatChoice = SliceParameters.N mod nbOption
SliceParameters.ChoiceSub = (SliceParameters.N - floor(SliceParameters.N/nbOption)) mod nbOption
SliceParameters.SubCategory = SubCategory.SubCategory
SliceParameters.Slicer = concat(SliceParameters.N, "-", SliceParameters.SubCategory)

table Slices[slice] small 200k = slice by [SliceParameters.N, SliceParameters.SubCategory] title: SliceParameters.Slicer
Slices.SubCategory = single(SliceParameters.SubCategory)
Slices.CatChoice = single(SliceParameters.CatChoice)
Slices.ChoiceSub = single(SliceParameters.ChoiceSub)

Catalog.Extend = nbOption^2 * nbSubCat
SubCategory.Extend = nbOption^2 * nbSubCat
table CatalogExtend = extend.range(Catalog.Extend)
CatalogExtend.SubCategory = Catalog.SubCategory
CatalogExtend.SubCategorySliced = ceiling(CatalogExtend.N/nbOption^2)
CatalogExtend.Slicer = concat((CatalogExtend.N mod nbOption^2) + 1, "-", CatalogExtend.SubCategorySliced)
keep where CatalogExtend.slice = same(SliceParameters.slice) by [SliceParameters.Slicer] at [CatalogExtend.Slicer]

table SubCategoryExtend = extend.range(SubCategory.Extend)
SubCategoryExtend.SubCategorySliced = ceiling(SubCategoryExtend.N/nbOption^2)
SubCategoryExtend.Slicer = concat((SubCategoryExtend.N mod nbOption^2) + 1, "-", SubCategoryExtend.SubCategorySliced)
keep where SubCategoryExtend.slice = same(SliceParameters.slice) by [SliceParameters.Slicer] at [SubCategoryExtend.Slicer]
SubCategoryExtend.SubCategory = SubCategory.SubCategory

/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Slices.CommentSub = single(SlicedFormSub.Comment) by [SlicedFormSub.SubCategory, SlicedFormSub.CatChoice, SlicedFormSub.ChoiceSub] at [Slices.SubCategory, Slices.CatChoice, Slices.ChoiceSub] when SlicedFormSub.IsValidated default("")

SubCatEnforcing.GrowthForced = SubCatEnforcing.GrowthForced/100

CurrentCA = sum(Forecast.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice)

                             if same(SubCatEnforcing.IsForced) by SubCatEnforcing.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory then same(SubCatEnforcing.GrowthForced) by SubCatEnforcing.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory
                             else single(CategoryParametrisation.GrowthSub) by CategoryParametrisation.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory

SubCategoryExtend.Slicer = concat((SubCategoryExtend.N mod nbOption^2) + 1, "-", SubCategoryExtend.SubCategorySliced)
keep where SubCategoryExtend.slice = same(SliceParameters.slice) by [SliceParameters.Slicer] at [SubCategoryExtend.Slicer]
SubCategoryExtend.SubCategory = SubCategory.SubCategory

/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
///# 2. Handle of the previous choices
/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

///## A] Looking at previous Slices and Data
Slices.IsValidatedCat = any(SlicedFormCat.IsValidated) by [SlicedFormCat.CatChoice] at [Slices.CatChoice]
Slices.IsValidatedSub = same(SlicedFormSub.IsValidated) by [SlicedFormSub.SubCategory, SlicedFormSub.CatChoice, SlicedFormSub.ChoiceSub] at [Slices.SubCategory, Slices.CatChoice, Slices.ChoiceSub]
Slices.CommentSub = single(SlicedFormSub.Comment) by [SlicedFormSub.SubCategory, SlicedFormSub.CatChoice, SlicedFormSub.ChoiceSub] at [Slices.SubCategory, Slices.CatChoice, Slices.ChoiceSub] when SlicedFormSub.IsValidated default("")

SubCatEnforcing.IsForced = SubCatEnforcing.IsForced or any(Slices.IsValidatedSub) by Slices.SubCategory at SubCatEnforcing.SubCategory
_, SubCatEnforcing.GrowthForced = tryParseNumber(field(SubCatEnforcing.Growth,"%",0), " ",".")
SubCatEnforcing.GrowthForced = SubCatEnforcing.GrowthForced/100

Catalog.CA = sum(Forecast.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice)
SubCategory.CurrentCA = sum(Catalog.CA)
CurrentCA = sum(Forecast.Baseline * Catalog.SellPrice)

/// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
///## B] Computing Growth Authorized
SubCategory.SelectedGrowth = if any(Slices.IsValidatedSub) by Slices.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory then max(F.GrowthMap(Slices.ChoiceSub)) by Slices.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory when Slices.IsValidatedSub else
                             if same(SubCatEnforcing.IsForced) by SubCatEnforcing.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory then same(SubCatEnforcing.GrowthForced) by SubCatEnforcing.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory
                             else single(CategoryParametrisation.GrowthSub) by CategoryParametrisation.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory

                             else single(CategoryParametrisation.GrowthSub) by CategoryParametrisation.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory
SubCategory.IsForced = any(Slices.IsValidatedSub) by Slices.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory or
                       same(SubCatEnforcing.IsForced) by SubCatEnforcing.SubCategory at SubCategory.SubCategory

SubCategory.CAExpected = SubCategory.CurrentCA * (1+SubCategory.SelectedGrowth)

IsCatForcedHighLevel = single(GeneralParametrisation.IsCatForcedHighLevel) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category
IsCatForced = single(GeneralParametrisation.IsCatForced) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category

CatGrowth = if IsCatForcedHighLevel then single(GeneralParametrisation.GrowthCat) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category else      /// P1: Forced At High Level
            if IsCatForced and IsRunMAJ then single(GeneralParametrisation.GrowthCat) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category else  /// P2: Run MAJ with High Level
            if any(Slices.IsValidatedCat) then max(F.GrowthMap(Slices.CatChoice)) when Slices.IsValidatedCat else                          /// P3: Parametrized through Slice
            if (not (IsCatUnforced or IsRunMAJ) and CatGrowthForm/100 != same(CategoryParametrisation.GrowthCat)) then CatGrowthForm/100 else            /// P4: Parametrized through Form
            if (IsCatForced and not IsRunMAJ) then same(CategoryParametrisation.GrowthCat)                                                                    /// P5: Growth forced
            else single(GeneralParametrisation.GrowthCat) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category
IsCatForced = not IsCatUnforced and (IsCatForced or
                                     any(Slices.IsValidatedCat) or
                                     (CatGrowthForm/100 != same(CategoryParametrisation.GrowthCat) and not IsRunMAJ) or
                                     (same(CategoryParametrisation.IsForcedCat) and not IsRunMAJ))


///Additional constraint apply on Cat Growth
CatGrowth = min(CatGrowth, single(GeneralParametrisation.MaxGrowthCat) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category)
CatGrowth = round(CatGrowth,4)

SubCategory.ForcedCA = if SubCategory.IsForced then SubCategory.CAExpected else 0
SubCategory.ForcedCAAuthorised = SubCategory.ForcedCA * min(1,((1+CatGrowth)*CurrentCA /. sum(SubCategory.ForcedCA) into Scalar))
RemainingCA = (1+CatGrowth)*CurrentCA - sum(SubCategory.ForcedCAAuthorised)
UnForcedCA = sum(SubCategory.CurrentCA) when not SubCategory.IsForced
SubCategory.AuthorisedCA = if SubCategory.IsForced then SubCategory.ForcedCAAuthorised
                           else RemainingCA * (SubCategory.CurrentCA/UnForcedCA)

SubCategory.SelectedGrowth = SubCategory.AuthorisedCA / SubCategory.CurrentCA - 1

write SubCategory as '/Clean/LongTermPlanning/Parametrisation/Category_\{Category}.ion' with
  Category = Category
  SubCategory = SubCategory.SubCategory
  GrowthSub = SubCategory.SelectedGrowth
  GrowthCat = CatGrowth
  IsForcedSub = SubCategory.IsForced
  IsForcedCat = IsCatForced
  CommentCat = CommentCat

//   CatGrowth {numbers: percent}
//   single(GeneralParametrisation.GrowthCat) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category {numbers: percent}
//   IsCatForced
//   single(GeneralParametrisation.IsCatForced) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category

HasChangedForcedCat = IsCatForced != single(GeneralParametrisation.IsCatForced) by GeneralParametrisation.Category at Category
if HasChangedGrowth or HasChangedForcedCat
  write Scalar as "/Clean/LongTermPlanning/Trigger/General.ion" with
    Category = Category
    HasChangedGrowth = HasChangedGrowth

show markdown "Documentation" a11h16 with
  """
  ### Documentation

  __Setup suppliers__: editable table to configure suppliers parameters.

  Supplier = supplier name

  Leadtime = supplier leadtime in days, i.e. time between the order placement and the order delivery

  Order frequency = purchasing frequence from this supplier in days (e.g. an order frequency of 10 days means one buys every 10 days from this supplier)

  MOV = minimum order value in dollars imposed by the supplier for every purchase

  ContainerM3 = container size in cubic metres if needed

  On Hand Value = not a parameter but an indicator. Represents the current stock on hand associated to references of the given supplier

  Status = not a parameter. Automatic alert which identifies if all parameters values are valid. For example, if the leatime or the reorder frequency is negative, the status won't be "ok"

  __Setup Location__: editable table to configure stores (only needed for the dispatch optimization)

  Loc = store name

  Leadtime = transfer time from the main warehouse to the store

  Dispatch frequency = dispatch frequence from the main warehouse to the store (e.g. a dispatch frequency of 2 days means there is a transfer from the main warehouse to the store every 2 days)

  On Hand Value = not a parameter but an indicator. Represents the current stock on hand associated to references of the given store

  Status = not a parameter. Automatic alert which identifies if all parameters values are valid. For example, if the leatime or the dispatch frequency is negative, the status won't be "ok"

  """

show label "" a2h2 9b9b9b

/// --------------------------------- [ Edit Supplier ] ---------------------------------

/// --------------------------------- [ Editable Body ] ---------------------------------

Editable.CountItemsBySupplier = count(not Editable.IsEditable) by Editable.Supplier

keep where argwhichever() by [Editable.Supplier, Editable.IsEditable]
Editable.IsInBothFiles = count(Editable.*) by Editable.Supplier > 1
keep where not Editable.IsInBothFiles or Editable.IsEditable

Editable.IsValidLeadTime = Editable.LeadTime >= 0
Editable.IsValidReorderCycle = Editable.ReorderCycle >= 0

Editable.IsItemOk = Editable.IsEditable and Editable.IsValidLeadTime and Editable.IsValidReorderCycle
Editable.Status = if Editable.IsItemOk then "Ok" else "Not Configured"
Editable.StatusColor = if Editable.IsItemOk then "#FFFFFF" else "FFA1A1"
passiveColor = "#ABABAB"
Editable.StatusColorText = if Editable.IsItemOk then passiveColor else "#FF0000"


Editable.CurrentStockValue = sum(Catalog.StockOnHand * Catalog.BuyPrice) by Catalog.Supplier at Editable.Supplier default -1

keep where dem.N > 0

  [|"Product A", today-7, 65|]
  [|"Product A", today-14, 61|]
  [|"Product A", today-21, 64|]
  [|"Product A", today-28, 63|]
  [|"Product A", today-35, 56|]
  [|"Product A", today-42, 72|]
  [|"Product A", today-49, 65|]
  [|"Product A", today-56, 76|]
  [|"Product A", today-63, 78|]
  [|"Product A", today-70, 67|]
  [|"Product A", today-77, 52|]
  [|"Product A", today-84, 70|]

expect sales.Ref = sales.R

// Stats

Obs.ReorderFrequency = 2

[Reads: ActRwdDocsItems.ion]

expect sales.Ref = sales.R

// Stats

Obs.ReorderFrequency = 2
Obs.SLT = 8
Obs.POLeadTime = Obs.ReorderFrequency + Obs.SLT

where dem.demandModel > 0

  Obs.WOOUncovDemand, Obs.HoldingTime = actionrwd.reward(
    TimeIndex: dem.N,
    Baseline: dem.demandModel,
    Dispersion: Obs.dispersion,
    Alpha: Obs.alpha,
    StockOnHand: Obs.SOH,
    LeadTime: dirac(Obs.SLT),
    StepOfReorder: Obs.ReorderFrequency,
    ArrivalTime: dirac(dem.N),
    StockOnOrder: dem.inboundStock)

  Obs.DemandOnRW = actionrwd.segment(
    TimeIndex: dem.N,
    Baseline: dem.demandModel,
    Dispersion: Obs.dispersion,
    Alpha: Obs.alpha,
    Start: dirac(Obs.SLT),
    Duration: dirac(Obs.ReorderFrequency) )

  Obs.TotalDemandPOLT = actionrwd.segment(
    TimeIndex: dem.N,
    Baseline: dem.demandModel,
    Dispersion: Obs.dispersion,
    Alpha: Obs.alpha,
    Start: dirac(0),
    Duration: dirac(Obs.POLeadTime) )


Obs.SatisfiedDemand = round(mean(Obs.DemandOnRW) - mean(Obs.WOOUncovDemand))
Obs.TotalDemandRLT = Obs.WOOUncovDemand + dirac(Obs.SatisfiedDemand)



Obs.SellThrough = (1-cdf(Obs.WOOUncovDemand + 1)) //* uniform.right(1))

show scalar "Sell Through" c25e28 {tileTab: "Ex"} with same(Obs.SellThrough)
Obs.SellThrough = Obs.SellThrough + uniform.left(72)

show scalar "Sell Through2" a63  {tileTab: "Ex"} with same(Obs.SellThrough)

show scalar "Holding Time" f25h28 {tileTab: "Ex"} with same(Obs.HoldingTime)
meanuncov = same(mean(Obs.WOOUncovDemand))
show scalar "Uncovered Demand on WOO, μ=\{meanuncov}" d21h23 {tileTab: "Ex" ; color: "darkred"} with same(Obs.WOOUncovDemand)
meantotal = same(mean(Obs.TotalDemandPOLT))
show scalar "Demand on Entire SLT and WOO, μ=\{meantotal}" d15h17 {tileTab: "Ex" ; color: "lightblue"} with same(Obs.TotalDemandPOLT)
meanRW = same(mean(Obs.DemandOnRW))
show scalar "Demand on WOO, μ=\{meanRW}" d18h20 {tileTab: "Ex" ; color: "lightgreen"} with same(Obs.DemandOnRW)
show scalar "Total Demand on WOO (Uncovered + Satisfied)" c39e41 {tileTab: "Ex" ; color: "orange"} with same(Obs.TotalDemandRLT)

Obs.Fillrate = fillrate(Obs.TotalDemandRLT)
Obs.CurrentFR = int(Obs.Fillrate, 0, Obs.SatisfiedDemand)

show scalar "Fillrate" f39h41 {tileTab: "Ex" ; color: "gold"} with same(Obs.Fillrate)

Obs.M = 38
Obs.S = 0.4*Obs.M
Obs.C = ((0.3 * 7)/365) * 8
Obs.Reward = Obs.SellThrough * (Obs.M + Obs.S) - Obs.HoldingTime * Obs.C

show scalar "Margin" a62 {tileTab: "Ex" ; color: "darkgreen"} with whichever(Obs.SellThrough*Obs.M)
show scalar "Stockout Penalty" c62 {tileTab: "Ex" ; color: "darkblue"} with whichever(Obs.SellThrough*Obs.S)
show scalar "Carrying Cost" d62 {tileTab: "Ex" ; color: "darkred"} with whichever(-Obs.HoldingTime*Obs.C)
show scalar "Reward" b62 {tileTab: "Ex" ; color: "blue"} with whichever(Obs.Reward)

table Extend = extend.ranvar(Obs.TotalDemandRLT)

Extend.Margin = int(Obs.SellThrough*Obs.M,Extend.Min,Extend.Max)
Extend.SOO = int(Obs.SellThrough*Obs.S,Extend.Min,Extend.Max)
Extend.CarryingCosts = int(-Obs.HoldingTime*Obs.C,Extend.Min,Extend.Max)
Extend.Reward = int(Obs.Reward,Extend.Min,Extend.Max)
Extend.Margin,Extend.SOO  = match Extend.Min with
  65 -> (76,30.4)
  67 -> (76,30.4)
  69 -> (76,30.4)
  71 -> (76,30.4)
  .. -> (Extend.Margin,Extend.SOO)


table test = with
  [| as min|]
  [|Extend.Min|]

  This includes demand that will be met by our current stock on order and stock on hand, as well as the demand we are taking action to cover
  over the window of opportunity.
  * **Demand on WOO:** The demand on the WOO is the demand distribution over our entire window of opportunity.
  * **Uncovered Demand on WOO:** The uncovered demand on the WOO is the demand distribution we are interested in covering by the action we are taking
  right now. This represents the demand that is not covered by the current stock on hand and stock on order based off the demand that will be served over
  the supplier leadtime. Any negative demand on this distribution represents units that are already covered by the current stock available.

"""

  * **Holding Time:** the holding time is the mean of the distribution of the holding timespan, which is the time in periods between when the unit is
  received and is available to be serviced and the point in time in which it is finally serviced.
  * **Sellthrough:** the sellthrough is the probability to sell a specific unit of uncovered Demand.

  The entire Lokad documentation on Action Reward can be found [[here]](https://docs.lokad.com/reference/abc/actionrwd.reward/).

  #### Economic Factors

  From an economic perspective the three main variables considered are the gross margin, the stockout penalty, and the carrying cost.

  The _gross margin_ is calculated from the final sell price agains the item buy price, but can also include other costs that take away from the final
  margin (additional transport costs to final warehouse/store, etc.)

  The _stockout penalty_ is the negative impact of stocking out and not being able to satisfy Demand.

  The gross margin and stockout penalty are both functions driven by the Demand. If a unit is not serviced with the coverage timespan, then its gross margin
  does not belong to the present order, but a future one. Conversely, if the unit is sold during the coverage period, the lack of the unit could generate a
  stockout and a loss of sales. Thus, from an action reward persepctive the margin and stockout penalty are largely correlated.

  The _carrying cost_ represents the financial cost of storing a unit of stock. This factor is based off of the _holding time_ of a unit which is the time from
  when the unit arrives and is available to be serviced until it is serviced. Action reward assumes that the only way to lower the current stock is by selling a
  unit, and thus the negative impact of the carrying cost is felt throughout the entire holding time.

"""

where date >= min(Items.LaunchDate) by 1
  show linechart same("\{Items.id} - Seasonality group \{Items.SelectedGroup} (\{Items.SelectedGroupItemsNb} items)") by slice a36c36 slices:ItemsWeek.slice with
    sum(ItemsWeek.DemandQty) as "Sales" {color: "red"}
    sum(ItemsWeek.SmoothedDemandQty) as "Smoothed Sales" {color:"green"}
    sum(ItemsWeek.LowerBarTotal2) as "Possible Low" {color: #(colorCold)}
    sum(ItemsWeek.LowerBarTotal1) as "Certain Low" {color: #(colorMed)}
    sum(ItemsWeek.HighBarTotal2) as "Possible High" {color: #(colorMed)}
    sum(ItemsWeek.HighBarTotal1) as "Certain High" {color: #(colorCold)}

    same(ItemsWeek.Cache) as "Life" {seriesType: background ; color: #d1ffff}
    sum(ItemsWeek.Baseline) as "Model" {color: #3C63CE}
    group by ItemsWeek.Monday

  where ItemsWeek.Cache > 0
    show linechart same("\{Items.id} - Above: \{Items.SalesAboveQuantileTargetDisplay}% - At: \{Items.SalesEqualQuantileTargetDisplay}% - Below: \{Items.SalesBelowQuantileTargetDisplay}%")
                    by slice a37c37 slices:ItemsWeek.slice with
      sum(ItemsWeek.DemandQty) as "Sales" {color: "red"}
      sum(ItemsWeek.SanityQTarget) as "Model \{sanityQTargetDisplay}% target"
      if all(ItemsWeek.DemandQty > ItemsWeek.SanityQTarget) default false then 1 else 0 as "Above target" {seriesType: background ; color: #b4c8dd}
      if all(ItemsWeek.DemandQty == ItemsWeek.SanityQTarget) default false then 1 else 0 as "At target" {seriesType: background ; color: #b9e78c}
      if all(ItemsWeek.DemandQty < ItemsWeek.SanityQTarget) default false then 1 else 0 as "Below target" {seriesType: background ; color: #ffe7bf}
      group by ItemsWeek.Monday

  show scalar same("\{Items.id} - SLT Demand") by slice d36e37 slices:slice with same(Items.SLTDemand)
  show scalar same("\{Items.id} - WOO Demand") by slice f36g37 slices:slice with same(Items.WOODemand)
  show scalar same("\{Items.id} - Total Demand") by slice h36i37 slices:slice with same(Items.TotalDemand)

///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
///-----------------------------------------EXPORT--------------------------------------------------
///~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

show linechart "ItemsWeek" with
  sum(mean(ItemsWeek.Demand)) as "Forecast"
  sum(ItemsWeek.DemandQty) as "Demand"
  group by ItemsWeek.week

where ItemsWeek.Monday >= oend - 2 * 365
  show table "Forecast" f4i4 write: "\{testStorage}Clean/Forecast/Periodic/WeeklyFc.ion" with
    Items.Id as "Sku"
    Items.SelectedGroup
    ItemsWeek.Monday

    ItemsWeek.DemandQty
    ItemsWeek.SmoothedDemandQty

    ItemsWeek.Cache
    ItemsWeek.IsPast
    ItemsWeek.FutureWeekRank
    ItemsWeek.IsSLT
    ItemsWeek.IsWOO
    ItemsWeek.IsWOODispatch

    Items.Alpha
    Items.Dispersion

    ItemsWeek.Baseline
    ItemsWeek.Demand

    ItemsWeek.LowerBarTotal2
    ItemsWeek.LowerBarTotal1
    ItemsWeek.HighBarTotal2
    ItemsWeek.HighBarTotal1

    ItemsWeek.CumDemand
    Items.WOODemand
    Items.WOODemandDispatch
    Items.SLTDemand
    Items.TotalDemand

// Seasonality not learned by group anymore
show table "Export Output Parameters" a4e4 write:"\{testStorage}Clean/Forecast/Periodic/FcItems.ion" with
  Items.Id
  Items.SelectedGroup
  Items.Affinity1
  Items.Affinity2
  Items.Affinity3
  Items.Affinity4
  Items.Affinity5
  Items.Affinity6
  Items.Affinity7
  Items.Affinity8
  Items.Affinity9
  Items.Affinity10
  ItemsYW.Profile1
  ItemsYW.Profile2
  ItemsYW.Profile3
  ItemsYW.Profile4
  ItemsYW.Profile5
  ItemsYW.Profile6
  ItemsYW.Profile7
  ItemsYW.Profile8
  ItemsYW.Profile9
  ItemsYW.Profile10
  Items.Level
  ItemsYW.SeasonalityModel as "TSeason"
  Items.Levelshift
  ItemsWeek.LinearTrend
  ItemsWeek.Baseline
  lastDate
  firstDate
  maxEpochs
  Items.GapToTarget
  Items.CategoryGapToTarget
  overallGapToTarget
  Items.ForecastSanityLabel
  Items.CategoryForecastSanityLabel
  overallForecastSanityLabel
  sanityQTarget
  quantileLow1
  quantileLow2
  quantileHigh1
  quantileHigh2
